tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// smon lam gyi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa thar lam bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

smon lam gyi rim pa byang chub mchog gi gru gzings zhes bya ba bzhugs so// zhing khams rgya mtsho mnga' mdzad pa'i// rgyal ba rgya mtsho nyan rang tshogs// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha// chos skyong rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol// 'di ltar bsod nams dpag med las grub pa'i// rmad byung byang chen dge 'bras bla na med// sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa'i zla med srol// mi yi seng ge lhar bcas mchod gnas gyur// e ma bo dhi sa twa'i bslab pa rnams// nyams med gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang*// byang chub sems mchog 'bral ba med bzhin du// log phyogs bdud kyi las rnams spang bar shog /brtse chen byams pa'i thugs dang ldan rnams kyi// gzhan don tshad med ji ltar 'byung ba dang*// bde gshegs ston pa mchog gi dgongs pa'i don// ma gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro la 'byung gyur cig /mngon shes drug ldan rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// chos mchog rig grol bslab ldan dge 'dun tshogs// mchog gsum bkra shis mkha' dbyings klong yangs nas// rnam kun bde legs nyin byed gsal gyur cig / ces pa'ang 'gro ba'i mgon gyur sgrub brgyud rin po che'i lam srol rjes su slob pa'i yid can rnam dag tshul khrims rgyan spras gnas mtshungs karma mtshan bzang gis 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa slob pa'i skabs/ kwan ting tā yi si tus smon lam shis brjod rten 'byung gi ched du bris pa ste dge legs su gyur cig /kye ma deng dus snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i// rang mdangs ches cher ston pa'i skabs 'dir yang*// byang chen spyod pa'i rjes su slob 'di dag /legs so legs so bskal bzang mchog tu gyur/// / ༈ rgyal kun ngo bo pad+ma 'byung*// gnyis med ye shes rnam rol ba// gdul dka' sgrol mdzad dpal chen po// grub pa'i dbang phyug pak+shi rje// snang stong 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku// tshangs dbyangs grag stong ldan pa'i gsung*// mkha' ltar yangs pa'i bde stong thugs// sku gsum yon tan yongs rdzogs pa// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i nyi ma che// 'gro drug ma rig mun pa sel// legs pa'i lam mchog gsal ston pa// grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba po// dpal ldan karma ka zhes grags// 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing*// de snyed rjes 'dzin mgon po mchog

/bstan 'gro'i ngal ba ring bskrad pa'i// snying rje tshad med skur bzhengs pa// sprul pa'i skyes mchog phreng ba las// bcu gsum bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhabs// rgyal kun ngo bo thugs rje can// snyigs dus gdul bya'i bsod nams zhing*// dpal yon bzang por yongs su grub// rnam par 'dren pa mchog gang la// bdag lus rdul snyed sprul nas ni// dad pa'i blo yi gdung shugs kyis// yan lag sa la gus btud de// 'khor lo'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// lus dang longs spyod dus gsum gyi// dge tshogs gcig tu bsdus nas ni// rmad byung dri med man+ḍal 'di// 'bul lo bzhes nas byin gyis rlobs// thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// lus ngag yid kyi mi dge'i las// nongs par gyur pa'i tshogs ji snyed// bshags so dag tshangs dngos grub stsol// rgyal rnams thugs bskyed dpag dka' ba'i// zab mo rgya chen phrin las kyis// mthong thos dran reg smin grol ba'i// gzhan don tshad med rjes yi rangs// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// skal bar 'tshams pa'i dam chos kyi// 'khor lo rim pa gsum gyi don// bskor bar gsol lo thugs rje can// zla med mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i sku// yan lag drug cu'i gsung gi mdzod// ji snyed mkhyen pa'i thugs mnga' ba// gsang gsum 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku// mi shigs rdo rje mi 'gyur ba// g.yung drung mi 'jigs seng ge khrir// g.yo med rtag par brtan bzhugs nas// 'od mi 'gyur bzhin zhabs brtan gsol// bdag gis dge ba'i las bgyis dang*// bgyid du stsal ba'i dge ba des// 'khor ba'i duḥkhar spyod pa rnams// myang 'das chen por 'god par shog /bdag ni tshe rabs kun tu yang*// bla ma dpal ldan karma pa// nam yang 'bral med gus mchod cing*// dam pa'i bdud rtsi'i dpal spyod nas// rang byung lhan skyes don dam pa// gnyug ma'i ye shes mngon gyur nas// bla med sku bzhi'i rgyal sa che// myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs// ji srid de ma thob kyi bar// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i las dbang gi

/mi mthun nyer 'tshe bdud rigs kyis// rlom pa'i las rnams spang bar shog /de ltar yid kyi pad+mo las// byung ba'i dri bsung ngad ldang ba// dad pa'i ser bus bskul byas te// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gzhir gyur cig /rgyal dang des gsung chos dge 'dun// mchog gsum byin rlabs stobs chen pos// deng 'dir smon lam dge tshogs rnams// ma lus lus med 'grub gyur cig /bka' brgyud rin chen grub pa'i dbang*// rgyud bzhir 'brel ba'i yi dam lha// dpal mgon dam can srung ma'i tshogs// rtsa gsum bkra shis 'byung gyur cig / ces pa'ang bsam gtan mchog gling gi bya btang ba dge slong mdzes ldan gyi thugs bzhed ltar/ si tu sprul sku pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos sgra rgyal 'brug gi lo sa zla'i yar tshes kyi dkar phyogs la thub bstan gling nas bris pa ste/ lar smon lam gsol 'debs sogs rgyal mchog yab sras rnams kyis bstsal ba'i sde tshan dang*/ khyad par mdo sde phal chen las byung ba'i smon lam sogs gsung gi bden tshig 'grub pa'i 'phags pa rnams kyis bkral ba dag gi rjes su slob par zhu zhing*/ bdag lta so skyes smos pa'i rang bzhin gtad med kyi tshig gis phan pa cher mi mngon pas de ltar thugs mtshor bstim pa zhu zhu/// / ༈ bde ba can gyi smon lam mkha' lding shugs 'chang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru a mi ta bha ya/ de bzhin gshegs pa lha rnams kun gyi lha// stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// tshe dang ye shes dpag med 'od mtha' yas// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i mchog der gus pas 'dud// gang tshe mnyan yod rgyal byed skyed mos tshal// mgon med zas sbyin kun dga' ra ba ru// ston pa don kun yongs grub shākya'i tog /'khor du byang sems nyan thos dpag med dang*// lha mi'i 'khor tshogs du mas yongs bskor dbus// shes rab mchog la gdams te bsngags pa'i gnas// nub phyogs zhing khams bye ba khrag khrig 'bum// de yi pha rol bde can pad+mo bkod// gzi brjid rgyal po 'od dpag med pa'i zhing*// phun tshogs lnga ldan dpal gyi yon tan brgyan// kun nas rnam par snang ba'i 'od kyis gsal// rmad byung mtha' yas bkod pa bla na med// bsam brjod bral ba'i zhing gi ston mchog der// rtag par rgyun gyi phyag 'tshal sgo gsum 'dud// dngos dang yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul/

sgrib gnyis bag chags dbang gyur nyes bshags sdom// theg chen byang chub spyod la yi rang ngo*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal rnams chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// bgrang yas bskal par 'gro don bzhugs gsol 'debs// dus gsum dge tshogs chos dbyings chen por bsngo// bdag dang bdag la 'brel ba'i lus can rnams// nam zhig sgyu ma'i g.yar khang 'jig nye'i dus// ci bya gtol bral ngang du gnas pa'i tshe// blo gtad ling skyur rtse gcig gsol 'debs na// bla ma dang ni dbyer med bde ldan mgon// ston pa mchog nyid yid ngor mngon sum du// rtogs pa'i tshad med byin rlabs 'brel ba dang*// sngon tshe zhal bzhes byang chub thugs bskyed ltar// bde ba can der ta ler 'pho nus shog /de lta'i smon lam 'brel pa mtha' btsan phyir// deng bzung ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du yang*// skyabs med skyob pa'i mgon du khyod la gsol// nyon mongs bag chags mthug po'i dbang gis ni// thar pa'i lam bzang sgrib par srid na yang*// brtse chen mgon gyi thugs rjes 'dor ram ci// myur bar phyag gis 'dren par mdzad du gsol// gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs bcom ldan 'das// mi 'khrugs rgyal ba nyi zla'i sgron ma dang*// mtha' yas mgon po 'od 'phro phung po che// seng ge tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan la sogs pa// bde gshegs kun gyi dbugs dbyung bden pa'i gsung*// gang zhig ji ltar de nyid yongs smin cing*// phyir mi ldog pa bde chen zhing bgrod nas// rgyal bas dbang bskur lung bstan thob par shog /de ltar smon lam mtshams sbyor dag pa dang*// bdag sogs dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams// zhing mchog 'jug phyir yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// kun kyang bla med byang chub thob gyur cig / ces pa'ang hor sgrub chen karma mi pham bshes gnyen dpal bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor si tu pas spel ba maṅga laṃ/// /

༈ bde chen zhing smon thar 'dod dad pha'i lcags kyu zhes pa bzhugs/ bdag gi dus gsum dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams// dkon mchog rin chen gsum la 'bul bar bgyi// de yi legs byas ji snyed mchis so cog /mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam yongs la bsngo// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rgyu bcas dag gyur cig /rab dkar dge tshogs tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho yi// byang chub spyod pa'i lhag bsam stobs dag gis// bdag dang bdag la 'brel ba'i yid can rnams// mi rtag g.yar khang 'jig par nyen pa na// skyabs gnas thugs rje can gyi bde bar gshegs// bcom ldan 'od snang dpag tu med ba'i mgon// lha tshogs rnams la rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs// las snang gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i g.yul ngo zlog /gnyug ma'i 'od gsal bde chen ye shes kyi// rang rig don dam ngo bo 'phrod gyur nas// bde blag nyid du lam sna drang du gsol// nub phyogs bde ba can du skye bar shog /ston pa sangs rgyas bla ma tshe mtha' yas// dngos su zhal mthong bdud rtsi dam pa brnyes// phyogs bcu'i rgyal rnams mchod cing 'jig rten khams// 'dren pa'i ded dpon nyid du 'grub par shog /mchog gsum rtsa gsum yongs 'dus rigs kun bdag /snang mtha' yas pa chos grub rgya mtsho yis// deng 'dir ji ltar smon lam 'grub pa yi// bla med bden pa dam pas skyong gyur cig /tad+ya thā/ pañtsa pri ya a ba bho dha na ya swā hā/ zhes smon lam brjod par bya'o// de ltar tshul 'dir smon lam gyi blo can dad gsum ldan pa sgrub chen nges legs mthar phyin gyi ngor/ si tu pas spel ba don ldan du gyur cig /bkra shis/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs 'od dpag med// mchog gi zhing khams bde ldan pad+mo bkod// bdag sogs 'brel bcas skye gzhan bar ma chod// brdzus 'khrungs ston pa'i zhal mthong lung bstan thob// byang chub spyod pa mthar phyin 'gro ba'i don// yongs 'grub mthar thug rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog

/ lha mgar karma bzang po'i ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ na mo a mi ta bha ye/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus rgyal ba'i rgyal// 'dren pa tshe 'od dpag med mgon po la// sgo gsum phyag 'tshal mchod cing nyes kun bshags// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs// rang gzhan dge tshogs byang chub thob phyir bsngo// gnas skabs chos mthun bsam dpyod legs 'grub cing*// nam zhig bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su// skye gzhan bar ma chod par brdzus skyes su// ston pa mchog gi zhal mthong sa lam gyi// yon tan yongs rdzogs sprul pas 'gro kun gyi// mgon du 'gyur cing ma gyur sems can rnams// bla med rdzogs sangs go 'phang thob gyur cig / karma don dam ngor spel ba dge// bde ldan zhing gi mgon po yi// byin rlabs thugs rje'i 'od snang gis// 'gro blo'i sgrib mun gtan bcil nas// yang dag thar pa'i lam 'god shog / ces dge slong la'o/// / ༈ bde ba can gyi zhing mgon 'od mi 'gyur// sras dang slob mar bcas la gus phyag 'tshal// dus gsum dge tshogs sems can don phyir bsngo// kun kyang bde ldan pad+mo bkod zhing du// skyes te rgyal ba'i zhal mthong bla med kyi// lung bstan mchog thob slar yang phyogs bcu yi// sangs rgyas zhing bgrod sprul pa du ma yis// 'gro rnams phyir mi ldog pa'i sar bkod shog / ya gri dbang rgyal ngor spel/// / ༈ yon tan bsam brjod bral ba bde can zhing// ston pa sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku// sras dang slob bcas thugs rjes deng dgongs la// bdag dang 'brel gyur sems can ji snyed pa'i// dus gsum dge tshogs byang chub thob phyir bsngo// de mthus mchog gi zhing khams dam pa ru// skyes te bla med lung bstan myur thob nas// sprul bsgyur du mas 'gro ba'i mgon gyur cig / karma chos ldan ngor spel/// / ༈ dpal ldan stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag bde bar gshegs// ma lus 'dus pa'i thugs rje'i rang bzhin can// bcom ldan sangs rgyas 'od snang mtha' yas la// mi phyed dad pas kun tu phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag mchod phul nyes tshogs nongs pa bshags// dge la yi rang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol dus gsum gyi// bsags pa'i dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo// mtha' bral yon tan brjod par dka' ba yi// dag pa'i zhing mchog bde chen pad+mo bkod// ston pa gzi brjid rgyal po tshe 'od mgon// lha dang lha mo dpag med kyis bskor ba// bdag dang bdag gi 'brel thogs sems can rnams// nam zhig rgyal ba'i zhal mthong lung bstan thob// bla na med pa phyir mi ldog pa yi// go 'phang dam pa bde blag nyid thob shog

/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum gyi// tshad med bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// smon lam ji bzhin 'grub par shog /tad+ya thā pañtsa bri ya a ba bho dha na ye swā hā/ zhes lha bris pa karma rnam dag ngor spel/// / ༈ 'khor 'das kun khyab gdod ma'i mgon// o rgyan snang mtha'i thugs rje yis// 'gro rgyud sgrib gnyis drungs phyung ste// bsam don lhun grub gtan 'dun gyi// chos rnams gegs med yongs smin nas// sku lnga'i bdag nyid chen po yi// go 'phang bde blag nyid thob nas// kun kyang bde chen sar 'god shog / ces bla ma legs bshad ngor spel/// / ༈ 'od snang mtha' yas sgyu 'phrul las// 'khrungs pa'i ston mchog zhwa dmar gyi// cod pan 'chang ba bcu pa mchog /mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho la// rnam kun gsol 'debs gus phyag 'tshal// skye nas skye bar 'bral med cing*// pad+mo bkod pa'i zhing khams der// tshe 'phos gyur tshe skye bar shog /skyes nas 'gro ba'i don 'byung shog / ces brtson 'grus ngor spel/// / ༈ bde ldan pad+mo bkod par 'od dpag mgon// o rgyan yul du sprul sku pad+ma 'byung*// gangs can ljongs su zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin// rab 'byams zhing gi bdag po gang der 'dud// deng bzung byang chub snying por gyur gyi bar// dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i yon tan yongs rdzogs nas// dpag med brjod bral dag pa'i zhing khams der// rgyal ba'i gsung gi dbang phyug thob par shog// / ༈ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems sras dang bcas// rgyal ba rab 'byams thugs rje kun 'dus pa// bde ldan zhing gi mgon po 'od mi 'gyur// dbyer med dpal ldan chos grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs// bdag sogs dus gsum dus med 'gro ba yis// phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs dge tshogs byang chen bsngo// rnam grol lam bkod bla med 'phags pa yi// smon pa'i 'dod don lhun grub byin rlobs la// pad+mo bkod pa'i zhing mchog der skyes nas// phyir mi ldog pa sangs rgyas sar 'god shog

ces khra phug sprul skus bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ thabs mkhas gang 'dul der snang ston mdzad cing*// srid mtsho'i 'jigs sgrol yang dag lam bzang po'i// go 'phang dam par mngon du sbyor ba'i dpal// bde ldan zhing gi rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal// bdag lus phra rab rdul gyi grangs 'das su// sprul nas dus gsum rang gzhan dge tshogs kun// thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob phyir// dngos dang yid sprul dag pa'i snang ba yi// rang mdangs ngang las mchod pa chen mo 'bul// rig pa'i rang rtsal gnyug ma'i dran shes kyi// yid byed sna tshogs 'phro 'du'i snang ba kun// gzhi rtsa bral ba'i spros bral ye shes kyi// gnas lugs ngo bo mthong bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe rabs kun tu dam chos snying po'i don// ma nor 'bras bu mngon du spyod par shog /dus gsum dge tshogs rgya mtshos yongs bskul te// bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa'i zhing khams mchog /byang chub sems dpa' chos grub rgya mtsho ni// sangs rgyas 'od dpag tshul du ston pa de'i// zhal mthong bla med myang 'das chen po yi// dbugs dbyung thob cing slar yang ji srid du// srid pa de srid 'gro sgrol ded dpon du// 'khor ba'i g.yang las skyob pa'i mthu ldan zhing// 'khor ba dong sprugs kun kyang sangs rgyas shog / gra lnga tshe brtan ngor spel/// / ༈ bde ldan zhing gi 'dren pa 'od dpag med// dbyer med sgyu 'phrul rol pa rigs kyi bdag /pad+ma gar dbang dbang gi cod pan can// mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs pad+mo// deng bzung bla med byang chen ma thob bar// 'bral med rjes 'dzin sgyu lus chu bur lus// yal ma thag der bde ldan zhing khams su// pad+ma'i sbubs su brdzus te skye bar shog /rgyal ba'i zhal mthong phyir mi ldog pa yi// go 'phang rin chen bde blag thob gyur cig / dpal sbas ngor spel/// / ༈ e ma hoḥ

gdod ma'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba dngos// dbang gi cod pan 'chang ba bcu pa mchog /mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs pad+mo// byang chub bar du 'bral med thugs rjes skyong*// bde ldan dag pa'i zhing khams dam pa ru// brdzus te skyes nas ston pa'i zhal mthong zhing*// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba'i lung bstan thob// sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal gyur cig / bcas dar rgyas ngor spel/// / ༈ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid mchog /rgyal ba'i zhing khams yongs kyi dpal 'dzin pa// nub phyogs bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa yi// ston pa 'od mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal 'dud// bla med snying rje'i dbang gis nyam thag 'gro// yal bar ma dor thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings nas// 'char ba'i sgyu 'phrul dbang gi cod pan can// phrin las 'od stong ldan der phyag 'tshal 'dud// zab mo'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug gis// srid zhi'i mun pa ring por mthar byed nas// don gnyis pad+ma'i myu gu bskyed nus pa'i// thugs rje mtha' yas mgon der phyag 'tshal 'dud// de ltar sgo gsum dad pa'i mos blo yis// grangs med rdul snyed lus rab yongs sprul te// phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// ston mchog 'od kyi snang ba mtha' yas la// phyag 'tshal mchod cing bshags dang rjes yi rang*// bskul zhing gsol 'debs dus gsum rab dkar dge'i// lhag bsam phung po gcig tu bzlums byas nas// bdag sogs 'khor ba'i 'dam las bsgral phyir bsngo// de mthus bdag kyang a 'thas sgyu ma'i lus// chu bur gyur ba'i 'dus byas stong pa'i tshe// bcom ldan ston mchog 'od dpag med mgon gyi// mtha' klas zab mo'i thugs rje rgyud bskul te// skad cig de ru mgon de'i zhing khams su// skye gzhan bar ma chod par brdzus skyes nas// rgyal ba'i zhal mthong chos kyi bdud rtsi thob// slar yang mgon med rnams kyi ded dpon du// sprul pa du mar 'dren pa'i dpal gyur shog

/de ltar rtse gcig yid kyi mos blo yis// bde chen zhing bdag mgon der gsol btab mthus// de bzhin nyid du 'grub par byin rlobs shig /sku gsum bdag nyid 'chi med pad+ma 'byung*// yi dam lha dang srung ma'i thugs rje'i mthus// ji ltar de ltar bde blag nyid 'grub par// smon lam yid la 'dod 'jo'i dpal gyur cig / ces pa'ang khams smyon dbon po bla ma dge legs kyi bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ hrīḥ phyogs dus rgyal ba rab 'byams zhing gi bdag /ma lus ji snyed 'dus pa'i gter chen po// bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi// ston mchog dam pa sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas// gsung gi dbang phyug dam pa'i phrin las kyi// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam par rol pa ni// rā ga'i cod pan 'chang ba'i phreng ba las// tshar du dngar ba dharma sir+dhan+dha// gang gi gsang gsum yon tan mi bzad par// bdag lus bye snyed lus sprul phyag 'tshal zhing*// mchod cing bshags so yi rang bskul gsol 'debs// dus gsum bsags dge mkha' khyab sems can kun// byang chub chen po myur thob phyir bsngo'o// bdag ni skye nas skye ba thams cad du// spyan ras gzigs dngos dpal ldan karma pa// mtha' yas rol pa dbang gi cod pan can// 'bral med rjes 'dzin chos mthun bsam pa kun// dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel nyid du 'gyur bar shog /chos min bslu chos mkhan dang mi 'phrad cing*// sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du mi 'gyur shog /nam zhig sgyu lus 'khrul pa'i dus byung tshe// sangs rgyas rgyal ba 'od snang mtha' yas kyi// sngon gyi thugs dam gnyen pos bskul bzhin du// bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa'i zhing khams su// pad+ma'i sbubs su brdzus te skyes nas su// zhal mthong gsung gi bdud rtsi'i gsang ba thob// sprul pas sems can gaṅgā'i klung bye snyed// de snyed rnams kyi 'dren pa'i dpal gyur shog

/bla med mchog gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// rtsa gsum bslu med bden pa'i thugs rje'i mthus// ji ltar gsol ba'i snying po'i rnam pa gang*// bde blag nyid du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig / de yang rdo rje'i tshig ldan sngon byon gong ma rnams kyis bstsal ba'i bde smon rigs mang du snang bas na de mthus 'khor mtsho las bsgral nus pa ni tshad ma nyid du gyur ba'o// 'di lta bu kho bo so skye'i bkod pa ni dgos pa nam yang dben cing nyi ma dang me khyer lta bur gyur kyang yor stod sngags rigs tshad ma'i rigs chos brgyud 'dzin dge slong karma dar rgyas kyi ngo ma ldog tsam du karma'i gdan sar spel ba dge legs 'phel/// / ༈ thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang 'od dpag med// deng bzung byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// bdag gis dus gsum dge tshogs gang bsags pa// 'gro drug sems can sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// sgyu lus mi rtag chos nyid gyur ma thag /bde ba can du brdzus skyes ston pa mchog /zhal mchod gsung gi bdud rtsis rgyud smin cing*/ sprul pas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i dpal du shog / rag shul be hu'i dra'i sangs tshe rgyal ngor spel/// / ༈ rang snang rnam dag bde chen pad+mo bkod// rang rig chos sku sangs rgyas 'od dpag med// rang byung spyan ras gzigs dngos karma pa// rang gsal ma 'gags byang sems nyan rang 'khor// du mas yongs bskor zhing mchog dam pa der// skye gzhan bar ma chod par brdzus skyes nas// rgyal dang rgyal sras zhal mthong lung bstan thob// sprul pas 'brel tshad 'dren pa'i ded dpon shog / rje btsun ma'i bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso dang chags bral ba// dam chos rig dang grol pa'i sar gnas tshogs// bla med mchog gsum 'di nas byang chub bar// skyabs gnas rtag tu 'bral ba med gyur nas// tshe dpal ye shes chos ldan longs spyod rgyas// dad dang dam tshig rnam dag tshul khrims ldan// lhar bcas bsngags 'os mchod pa'i zhing gyur nas// 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dpal la dbang 'byor shog

/nam zhig g.yar khang bor ma thag nyid du// bcom ldan snang mtha'i zhal mthong lung bstan thob// sprul pas 'gro 'dren phyir mi ldog nas su// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon gyur shog / ces brtson 'grus ngor spel/// / ༈ phyogs dus rgyal ba rab 'byams thugs rje gter// o rgyan chen po pad+ma kā ra mchog /brtse chen dbyings nas dgongs shig deng 'di ru// smon lam bden pa'i bden 'grub byin gyis rlobs// bdag sogs rnams kyi dus gsum bsags yod kyi// dge rtsa 'dzad med chu bo rnam bzhi'i rgyun// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rgya mtshor 'jug gyur nas// srid zhi'i gdung sel bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /de ma thob kyi tshe rabs skye kun tu// dal rten mchog thob dge ba'i bshes dang mjal// lta grub tshad ma'i bstan sgor zhugs nas kyang*// rgyal bstan rin chen gsal ba'i gnyen gyur shog /mkha' khyab sems can rnams kyi bde dge'i gzhi// ji ltar bsam don chos bzhin lhun grub pa'i// mthu dang nus pas yid srub dpung gzhom ste// byams pa'i go bgos snying rje'i bsgral 'dren shog /gang zhig rgyal ba mchog rnams gshegs pa'i shul// zab don snying po gsang sngags bla med kyi// chos tshul phyag rdzogs zung 'jug dbyer med pas// bdag rgyud smin sgrol gzhan phan ston nus shog /lhar bcas skye dgu'i mchod sdong rin po che// sangs rgyas bstan pa yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal// 'gro blo mos pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas// nam mkha' ci srid bar du mtha' rgyas shog /nges don bstan 'dzin byed po gang yin pa// kun kyang phrin las rnam bzhi'i stobs rgyas shing*// 'gro don thugs bskyed dam bca' ji bzhin par// bsnyel med zhabs brtan bzhed don yongs grub shog /lnga bdo'i snyigs mtha' 'dir yang legs byas kyi// rgyur gyur dgra bcom rjes slob 'dus pa'i tshogs/

thugs mthun chos bcu 'khor lo gnyis dang ldan// 'dul sdom rnam dag dge 'dun sde rgyas shog /tshangs dbang rgyal chen la sogs dkar phyogs skyong*// bstan la rab gus mngon par 'dud pa rnams// dpung tshogs stobs kyi mi 'jigs dpa' ba yi// nag po'i phyogs kyi g.yul las rnam rgyal shog /chos min chos ltar bcos pa'i bslu chos mkhan// ltar snang bzang po'i tshul 'chos bdud rlom pa'i// log bshes rnams kyang rtag tu snyems bral zhing*// tshul bzhin yang dag bstan la gus par shog /dmyal me'i bud shing sgrub la mngon 'dod cing*// las kyi blang dor phyin ci log sems pa'i// dge min spyod la brtson pa'i rje bo dag /las 'bras chos la ji bzhin bden mthong shog /sngon tshe smon mthu'i 'bras rnyed dge bcu yi// rjes mthun sgrub brtson 'brel thogs ji snyed kun// tshe ring nad bral bsam don 'bad med 'grub// rtag tu dge zhing dam pa'i chos ldan shog /'jig rten khams 'dir 'byung po'i gnod pa zhi// lo legs skya rgyal char chu dus 'bebs shing*// nad mug mtshon 'khrugs bskal ngan 'jigs chen bral// rdzogs ldan dang po'i dpal la 'gran nus shog /mdor na bdag gi 'brel gyur mchis so cog /dgra gnyen bar ma kun gyis thog drangs pa// ma gyur 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa'i// sems can thams cad tshad med bzhi thob shog /kun kyang 'dus byas sgyu lus bor ma thag /nub phyogs bde chen pad+mo bkod zhing du// skyes nas 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong zhing*// dbugs dbyung phyir mi ldog pa'i sar gnas shog /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang ni// slob mar bcas pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam gyi// rjes su slob pa'i deng 'dir smon 'dun kun// da lta nyid du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// ces pa'ang skyabs che bla ma bsod nams chos 'phel nas dad gsum rnam par dag pa'i mos blos bskul ba'i ngor/

si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba dge bar gyur cig// / ༈ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ kun bzang pad 'byung ar+ya tā re yum// dbyer med karma ka dang dpal 'brug pa// mchog gsum rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor la// gsol 'debs smon lam yongs 'grub byin gyis rlobs// bdag dang bdag la 'brel ba'i ltos bcas kyi// ma gyur 'gro ba'i bsam sbyor rnam dag gi /zag bcas zag med dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs// bla med byang chub go 'phang thob phyir bsngo// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun thugs mthun zhing*// 'jig rten bde dang rang gzhan tshe bsod dpal// 'phel zhing rnam dag bde chen zhing khams su// ston mchog zhal mthong rjes su 'dzin gyur cig / 'dzi sgar rgyal sras bla ma pad+ma dbang drag bzhed ltar spel/ shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ oṃ swasti/ kun bzang dgongs pa theg dgu'i yang snying bcud// pad+ma kā ra'i bzhed gzhung dgongs pa'i mthil// brgyud pa drug ldan lam rim kun 'dus pa// chos rgyal yab sras bka' babs gsang chen chos/ 1 /tshe gcig thar lam bsnyegs 'dod skal ldan la// med du mi rung byin rlabs drod tshad ldan// dus babs mkha' 'gro'i gtad rgya slar babs pa'i/ zab chos 'di ni yid bzhin nor las 'phags/ 2 /sngon bsags rnam par dkar pa'i chu shel snod// spangs rtogs yon tan rgya mtsho'i bcud kyis gtams// mdo rgyud lung rigs rnam dpyod rgyan ldan pa'i// 'dod 'byung bum bzang blo gros mtha' yas rgyal/ 3 /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi /thugs rje nus pa mtshungs zhes rdo rje'i bka'// des na bsod nams tshogs kyang de snyed kyi// yon tan mtha' dag deng 'dir rdzogs gyur cig 4 /'di bzhengs dge bas rgyal bstan spyi bye brag /khyad par rdo rje snying po'i ring lugs gang*// nub med phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// de 'dzin mchog rnams rtag brtan 'tsho gyur cig

5 /'jig rten khams su nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing*// char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs rtag tu legs// rdzogs ldan bde skyid dpal la spyod bzhin du// chos ldan snang bas phyogs mthar khyab gyur cig 6 /rten 'di bzhengs po don gnyis lhun gyis grub// 'gro don phrin las nam mkha'i mthar khyab cing*// gdod ma'i ye shes mngon gyur rang rig rtsal// pad+ma badz+ra mchog dang dbyer med shog /7 mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum gyi bden stobs dang*// rnam dkar dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum gyi// legs byas ji snyed mchis kun gcig bsdus te// kun kyang rdzogs sangs go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ 8 / ces kong po pas steng sprul sku mkhas mchog karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos/ bla ma dgongs 'dus gser chos pu sti bcu gsum bzhengs grub skabs smon lam bzhed ltar spel ba dza yan+tu/// / ༈ swasti/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs// bden pa grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag dang pha mas gtsor byas rigs drug gi /sems can sdug bsngal mtsho las bsgral du gsol// rang gzhan rnams kyi dus gsum dus med kyi// dge ba'i rtsa ba mchog gsum rtsa gsum lha'i// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rten mchog rnams// bzhengs pa'i legs byas byang chub chen por bsngo// de ma thob par tshe rabs kun tu yang*// dal rten thob cing mtshan ldan bla ma mjal// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas// smin cing grol ba'i lam bzang thob par shog /chos dang chos min ma nor ji bzhin par// gnas skabs tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*// nad gdon bar chad mi mthun nyer 'tshe zhi// rang byung lhan skyes 'od gsal phyag rgya che// gnyug ma chos sku'i rgyal sar dbang 'byor shog /nam zhig bde chen pad+mo bkod zhing du// brdzus te skyes nas sangs rgyas zhal mthong zhing*// bla med lung bstan dbugs dbyung thob nas su// phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang thob gyur cig

dad gsum 'gyur med chos tshul ldan pa karma'i bzhed ngor spel ba dge bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ ba wan+tu/// / ༈ mchog gsum ngo bo dpal ldan karma pa// bdud 'dul rdo rje snying gi thig le ru// byang chub bar du 'du 'bral med bzhin du// rang byung lhan skyes chos sku mngon gyur shog /dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs rnams// deng 'dir legs byas rnam dag rgya mtsho cher// 'jug nas thar pa'i go 'phang bde blag tu// thob cing dmigs yul sgrib gnyis byang gyur nas// sa dang lam gyi yon tan gong 'phel zhing*// gdod ma'i bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang chen dang*// dbyer med sems nyid spros bral bde ba che// dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig sangs rgyas shog / ces pa'ang lang 'gro lo tsā'i rnam 'phrul dbon sprul dbang gi rdo rjes bka' gnang ltar gang gi dbon po dad gsum rnam par dag cing lhag pa'i bsam pa zla snang ltar dkar ba tshe dbang nor bu 'da' ka mar smon lam du spel ba dge// / ༈ gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang pad+ma 'byung*// dbyer med grub pa'i spyi mes karma ka /bdud tshogs 'dul pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po// deng bzung byang chub bar du 'bral med shog /lhar bcas skye dgus mchod pa'i zhing gyur pa// nges don snying po sgrub brgyud kaṃ tshang gi /bstan pa ring lugs srol bzang 'dzin byed pa'i// yang dben bsam grub ri khrod ces bya bar// bsti ba'i las can skal par ldan pa rnams// sgo gsum nyes pa'i dri yis ma sbags par// pha rol phyin bcu'i gnas la slob nas su// rang gzhan dge la sbyor bar byed par shog /'khor chos sgyu ma'i 'phrul la yid skyo shas// nges 'byung blos bskul dam chos snying po la// rtag tu brtson zhing rang byung ye shes che'i// rtsal rdzogs gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan gang*// 'phel zhing rgyas nas gzhan don phrin las kyis// 'gro kun thar pa'i lam du 'jug byed pa'i// ded dpon dam par dbang bsgyur byin gyis rlobs//

zhes si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos ri mgul sprul pa'i sku nas bka' brgyud gong ma'i ring srol ji bzhin dben rir sgrub sde gsar 'dzugs skabs shis brjod smon lam bzhed ngor spel ba dge legs dar rgyas 'phel/ maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso mchog dpal// grub pa'i spyi mes nā ro pa'i// rnam 'phrul dpal ldan 'brug pa zhes// sa gsum snyan par grags pa can// bka' brgyud bstan ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// mchog gi sgrub brgyud nges don gyi// zab don snying po lhur len pa'i// rnal 'byor dbang phyug sprul pa'i sku// sngon bskal smon bzang 'brel ba'i mthus// pad+mas lung zin dge sbyong dang*// tsan+d+ra nirma kā la bcas// tshom bu gcig gis smin grol chos// mthong thos grol lam myur thob pa// bgo skal nyid du nod pa yis// bstan pa'i btsas dang gdul bya'i 'gro// don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig / ces mtsho 'jug sprul sku bstan 'dzin lhun grub la shis brjod dge/ shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ dpal rigs brgya'i khyab bdag karma pa// mchog dkyil 'khor kun gtso 'brug pa'i zhabs// don dbyer med rdo rje drag po rtsal// skye ba nas tshe rabs phreng ba ru// 'bral med cing dam chos zab mo'i don// mthar phyin nas don gnyis 'bras thob shog// / ༈ mchog gsum rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// o rgyan slob dpon pad+mā ka ra mchog /dbyer med 'khor lo'i mgon po bka' drin can// bdag snying pad+mor byang chub bar bzhugs gsol// rgyal ba rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing bdag po// ma lus lus med brtse bas 'dir dgongs la// ji ltar smon pa'i bden tshig 'grub gyur pa'i// thugs rje'i byin rlabs char rgyun dbab tu gsol// mkha' mnyam sems can ma rgan rigs drug po// phra rab rdul gyi grangs 'das 'gro ba dang*// khyad par nor skyong skal ldan las can 'di// tshe 'dir bde skyid bsam don lhun grub cing*// 'dus byas sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'jig pa'i tshe// skye gzhan bar ma chod pa o rgyan gyi// mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su// ston mchog pad+ma 'byung dang mi gnyis pa'i// ma nor lam ston tshe rabs 'brel ba'i mgon// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal mthong lung bstan thob// sprul pas 'khor ba'i mtsho chen myur skem nas// phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'god gyur cig

/ ces khyab bdag dam pa 'dzi sgar rin po che'i sku mdun gyi rgya khyi seng phrug spu ra la smon lam du si tus bris pa 'grub par gyur cig// / ༈ bde ldan zhing gi mgon po yi// byin rlabs thugs rje'i 'od snang gis// 'gro blo'i sgrib mun gtan bcil nas// yang dag thar pa'i lam 'god shog / ces dge slong la'o/// / ༈ rgyal kun mkhyen ba'i rang gzugs mchog /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin// gang gi thugs rje'i zla snang gis// bdag rgyud sgrib gnyis byang gyur cig / khyab brdal lhun grub la spel/// / ༈ ston mchog des gsung chos dge 'dun// rnam gsum thugs rje'i mkha' klong nas// byin rlabs chu khur phreng ba dkrigs// gdul bya mos blo'i sa gzhi ru// byang chub sems gnyis pad tshal rgyas// thar pa don ldan 'bras smin cing*// 'gro la phan bde'i dpal kun bskyed// rdzogs sangs rgyas thob nyid du shog / sbyin pa mthar phyin ngor si tus smras pa shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags yod kyi// dge tshogs thams cad gcig tu bzlums byas te// dge legs 'byung gnas dkon mchog gsum la 'bul// dge des 'brel thogs gyur pa'i sems can dang*// khyad par dmigs yul de dag sgrib gnyis kyi// khyad par las kyis snyems pa'i dbang gis ni// khyad par rtsa ba yan lag dam nyams pa// khyad par las gyur ji snyed sdom pa'i tshogs// bla med mchog gsum drung du mthol bshags nas// bla med brtse ba'i spyan gyis yongs dkyud de// bla med mchog gi tshangs par bstsal nas kyang*// bla med sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon gyur shog / ces yar gling bla rgan karma mchog dga' nas spun zla gshin po dbu phyag gnyis dang 'brel thogs rnams kyi dge rtsar bskul bzhin 'phen gyi rgyab byang du si tus spel/// / ༈ skyabs gnas dkon mchog byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag ni thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// lus ngag yid kyis mi dge'i las spyod pa// rang bzhin kha na ma tho'i spyod pa kun// thar med 'jig rten las ngan bsags pa'i rgyus// mi dge'i las gyur thams cad mthol lo bshags// sngar byas sdig pa ma lus bshags par bgyi// phyin chad mi bgyid dam bca' snying nas bzung*// deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar// ma nor lam ston bla ma dam pa dang*// 'bral ba med par dam chos sgor zhugs nas// skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs phreng ba kun// rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims gtsang mar gnas// chos spyod bcu yi sgrub pa mthar phyin nas// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas go 'phang thob gyur cig

/ ces pa 'di kun dga' ye shes nas bshags sdom rgyun khyer 'dod don bzhin si tus spel ba dge// / ༈ bcom ldan 'das ma tā re yi// byin rlabs 'od dkar 'dud rtsi'i rgyun// nyon mongs gdung sel stsol ba'i mthus// tshe dpal ye shes snang ba rgyas// mchog thun dngos grub dam pa thob// gtan bde'i 'bras bu smin gyur cig / ces ya kre mchog sbyin sogs kyi ngor spel ba dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ rgyal kun ngo bo karma pa// mthon mthing cod pan 'chang ba po// mā ra da ma ka badz+ra// tshe rabs kun tu mi 'bral zhing*// zab don chos kyi 'dud rtsi yis// smin cing grol ba'i lam 'god nas// bla med sku bzhi'i rgyal sa che// ring min myur du thob par shog / bi dza yas bskul ltar si tu pas dge// / ༈ yid bzhin 'khor lo bcom ldan ma// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mthu dpal gyis// ngag dbang yon tan zhes bya ba// tshe brtan dpal 'byor chos ldan zhing*// 'dod don yid bzhin lhun gyis grub// nam zhig mi gnas gyur ba'i tshe// longs sku'i zhing khams po ṭa lar// pad+ma'i spubs su 'khrungs gyur nas// zhing de'i ston mchog 'jig rten mgon// zhal mthong chos kyi bdud rtsi yis// rgyud grol 'gro la snying rje'i mthus// thar lam ston nus ded dpon shog / ces shor phu ngag dbang yon tan ngor spel/// / ༈ stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag bde bar gshegs// thub mchog bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mgon// rnam par 'dren pa karma ka /gang gi thugs rje'i 'od ris kyis// srid pa'i mun stug rab bsal te// gang 'dir mi mthun kun gzhil nas// tshe dpal ye shes snang ba rgyas// yid bzhin 'dod don yongs grub pa'i// myang 'das myur thob byin gyis rlobs// ces mang kwa dbang rgyal ngor a sgre la smon lam du spel ba su dza yan+tu/// / ༈ rtsa gsum spyi mes pad+ma 'byung*// gang gi mnyam med byin rlabs mthus// log phyogs bdud sde'i dpung tshogs kyis// glags ltar gyur pa'i bsam sbyor zhi// bde legs dpal la longs spyod cing*// don gnyis mthar phyin 'bras thob nas// bla med sku bzhi'i rgyal sa cher// 'god pa'i skal bzang thob gyur cig

/ ces mang kwa dbang rgyal nas bskul bzhin dpal 'byor la smon lam du spel ba dge// / ༈ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs bskyed mkha' klong nas// 'khrungs pa'i rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa'i bdag /srid gsum mun sel dpal ldan karma pa// yi dam lha dang chos srung mthu byin gyis// gang zhig nyes pa'i smag rum rtsad 'byin te// yang dag ye shes pad+mo'i tshal chen rgyas// mchog thun dngos grub ring min mngon du gyur// gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang thob par shog / ces pa'ang mang kwa bsod nams lags kyi ngor spel// / ༈ dpal ldan lha yi lhar gyur bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten mgon pos thugs rjes nyer dgongs la// sdug bsngal duḥkha'i rgya mtshor bying ba yi// 'gro drug sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol// deng nas bzung ste bla med byang chub bar// dal rten bzang thob dam pa'i rjes su zhugs// gsang sngags rdo rje theg mchog sgor 'jug cing*// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa'ang li yul ba a h+ya'i ngor spel/// / ༈ oṃ swasti/ ston pa mtshungs med shākya'i rgyal// des gsung chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum gyi// bden pa'i bden tshig zab mo'i mthus// nges pa don gyi snying po yi// ring lugs dri med yun du gnas// dar rgyas srid pa'i skye 'gro yi// bsod nams dpal du gyur nas su// lha dbang srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis// log phyogs bdud sde pha mthar bskrad// chos kyi rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgreng*// bkra shis lhun grub dpal ldan shog / ces pa'ang chos nyid sprul skus bskul bzhin rgyal bstan 'phel rgyas kyi smon lam du si tus spel ba maṅga laṃ// ༈ dkon mchog rtsa gsum thugs rje yis// deng 'dir bslab gsum rgyan ldan pa// gang khyod tshe rabs thams cad du// rgyal bstan snying po'i sgor zhugs shing*// mkha' khyab 'gro ba ji snyed pa// sgrol ba'i ded dpon gyur nas su// zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i// go 'phang dam par 'god gyur cig

/ ces pa'ang dge rgyas rtogs ldan rab 'byor la smon lam du spel ba'o/// / ༈ 'phags ma don kun sgrub byed kyi// byin rlabs ri bong 'dzin pa yis// deng 'dir mos ldan ku mud ta// bkra shis dge ba'i dpal spyod pa'i// chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa dang*// don gnyis lhun grub 'bras thob pa'i// rang byung don dam lhan skyes kyi// gnas lugs ngo bo mthong bar shog / li yul mchog sbyin pa'i dpal la smon lam du spel ba dge// / ༈ skyabs yul mchog gsum dam pa'i mgon// bde gshegs lha rnams kun gyi lha// rnam 'dren rgyal dang de sras la// dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas// bla med mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul// nongs par gyur pa'i las rnams 'chags// gzhan phan spyod la rjes yi rangs// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /bdag ni deng bzung byang chen bar// nges pa don gyi ring lugs kyi// sgor zhugs lam ston bla ma yis// rjes bzung smin cing grol gyur nas// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// byang grol lam la 'god gyur cig / ces sngags rgyud sbyin pa'i ngor smras pa dza yan+tu/// / ༈ rgyal kun gcig bsdus ngo bo nyid// pad+mā ka ra'i thugs bskyed las// 'khrungs pa'i rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs 'dzin// pad dkar 'chang ba thams cad mkhyen// gang gi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// skal ldan blo yi skyed tshal du// byang chub sems gnyis 'dab rgyas shing*// bde gshegs snying po'i don rtogs shog / ces brtson 'grus zhes pa'i ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ skyabs gsum thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// byin rlabs 'od stong ldan pa 'phro// 'gro ba'i las nyon sgrib mun bcom// skal ldan mos pa'i skyed tshal du// dad gsum rnam dag pad dkar bkra// bslab gsum rnam dag dri bsung can// karma rnam dag chos tshul ldan// mos gus rnam dag 'byongs par shog

/deng nas byang chen ma 'god bar// yongs 'dzin dam pas rjes bzung ste// smin grol lam bzang myur thob nas// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid 'gyur bar shog /dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i bden stobs dang*// chos dbyings don dam bden ba'i mthus// smon lam 'bras bu ji snyed pa// ring por mi thogs 'grub gyur cig / ces smug po gnas kyi kun spong dkon skyabs ngor/ rnam dag la smon lam du spel ba dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ srid zhi'i dpal gyur mgon po mchog /dpag dka'i phrin las 'od stong can// dpal ldan rje btsun karma pa'i// thugs rje'i byin rlabs mi bzad pas// thar 'dod skal bzang pad+mo'i tshal// log phyogs smag rum drungs phyung nas// dge tshogs 'dab stong spro bzhin du// rnam kun rjes su 'dzin par shog / ces pa'ang karma tshe brtan la spel/// / ༈ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mthu byin gyis// tshe rabs gtan dge'i dpal thob ste// zab mo chos kyi smin grol thob// skye dgu yongs la sman gyur cig /mchog gsum 'dus zhal karma pa// rtsa gsum lha yi bden pa dang*// chos dbyings bsam mi khyab ba'i mthus// de ltar smon lam myur 'grub shog / ces pa'ang a khying zhes pa'i ngor spel ba sarba dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs kyis// mtha' klas sems can ma lus kun// 'dren pa'i gnyen du gyur nas su// bstan 'gro'i btsas su smin pa yi// ji ltar yid la gang 'dod pa// ma lus 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig / tsha ko ba khro chu dge slong ye shes la'o/// / ༈ rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang gzugs nyid// dpal ldan sangs rgyas gnyis pa mchog /'chi med rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung*// gang gi gsang gsum mi zad pa// dpag med yon tan stobs dag gis// skye 'gro phan dang bde ba'i gzhir// nges don snying po'i ring lugs kun// mi nub phyogs mthar khyab gyur cig /

ces phan bde la smon lam du spel/// / ༈ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba yi// gsang gsum gcig bsdus karma pa// mgon de'i brtse chen ye shes kyi// thabs mkhas zab mo'i snang ba yis// skal ldan 'khor mtsho brgal 'dod dag /nges 'byung mos gus rdzing la brten// dag pa'i khang bzang rin chen gling*// sku bzhi'i nor bu thob par shog /ji srid de ma thob kyi bar// dpal ldan karma kaṃ tshang gi// bstan pa'i sgor zhugs yang dag gi// lam ston rdo rje slob dpon dang*// mi 'bral sgo gsum chos spyod kyi// sgrub pa mthar phyin skye dgu rnams// legs pa'i lam la dkri ba yi// phrin las rgya cher ston nus shog / ces pa'ang 'jang ri smug po'i rtogs ldan pa dkon mchog skyabs nas bskul bzhin si tus spel ba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ dpal ldan stobs bcu mnga' ba de bzhin gshegs// zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos mchog dang*// bslab ldan ngur smrig 'chang dbang saṃ gha shrī// bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa yis// yul ris sa phyogs grong rdal 'dir gnas pa'i// dpa' bo ḍā ki gnas srung yul lhar bcas// ma lus rgud pa'i mtshan ma gtan nas zhi// sangs rgyas bstan dang skye dgu'i dpal yon tshogs// gong du 'phel zhing skyong ba'i rtsal drag ldan// de yi mthu las gnas ljongs 'di nyid du// mi phyugs nad dang lo nyes 'khrugs rtsod zhi// char chu dus 'bab 'bru bcud lo tog 'phel// bstan pa'i snying po sgrub brgyud dar zhing rgyas// log 'dren bdud ris thal bar brlag gyur cig /mdor na sems can rnams ni ma lus pa// byang chub sems dang nam yang 'bral med shog /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas gyur cing*// rnam par dag pa'i dge la gzhol ba dang*// mthar thug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid 'grub gyur nas// rnam kun bkra shis snang bas khyab gyur cig / ces ya kre mang kwa dang te pu'i yul mi rnams kyis gnas gang la yang dge ba'i smon lam bskul bar brten/

mchu zla'i dkar phyogs bzang por thub bstan chos gling nas spel bar dge legs 'phel/// / ༈ ār+ya tā re'i thugs rje'i mkha' klong nas// rmad byung byin rlabs chu 'dzin phyogs bcur g.yo// dge legs 'dod pa 'jo ba'i char chen 'bebs// deng 'dir skal ldan 'dzin ma'i gzhi 'di ru// phan dang bde ba'i rkang 'thung rgyas gyur te// byang grol lam gyi 'bras bu yongs su smin// yid can 'gro ba'i gnyen du gyur nas su// rgyal bstan gsal bar byed pa'i gsos su shog / ces khra 'bu mang kwa ba'i 'dod don ltar cho 'phrul can gyi yar tshes la spel/// / ༈ rigs kun gtso bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// pradz+nyā bha dra nā ro paṇa chen sogs// zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po bka' brgyud kyi// grub pa'i dbang po mchog rnams thugs rje'i mthus// karma dar rgyas deng bzung byang chub bar// dal brgyad 'byor bcu ldan pa'i lus bzang thob// yang dag lam ston yongs 'dzin dam pa mjal// zab don chos kyi bdud rtsir longs spyod nas// gdod nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi// rang byung gnyug ma'i ngo bo gnas mthong zhing*// gzhan phan byang sems spyod pa rgya chen gyis// srid mtsho brgal ba'i ded dpon nyid gyur cig / ces li yul pa karma dar rgyas ngor spel ba dge tshogs yar zla ltar 'phel rgyas su gyur cig// / ༈ rgyal kun ngo bo gu ru rje// slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i// byin rlabs nyin byed 'od stong gis// skal ldan snying gi pad+mo'i tshal// gsal bar byas so thugs rje'i bdag /deng bzung bla med byang chub bar// brtse bas rjes 'dzin mchog gi lam// 'god pa'i skal bzang ldan gyur cig / ces dbang rgyal lags kyi thang sku'i rgyab zung du spel ba dge// / ༈ ston mchog thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// bstan ba'i snang byed karma pa// dngos grub chu 'dzin wā ra hi// ma hā kā la dbyar rnga'i bdag

/nor 'dzin zhing gi khyon yangs por// rgyal bstan pad+mo'i tshal ji snyed// rab rgyas mos ldan bung ba'i tshogs// dam pa'i rtsi yis 'tsho gyur cig / ces li yul ba dge slong sgrub mchog ngor thang ka'i rgyab zung du spel/// / ༈ bcom ldan rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad// lha tshogs ma lus 'khor bcas kyis// mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i las nyon las// byung ba'i ngan song sbyong du gsol// bde bar gshegs dang rgyal sras tshogs// slob mar bcas pa'i thugs rje'i 'od// bdag sogs nongs pa'i smag rum rnams// rab tu bsal ba'i dbugs dbyung stsol// ces dge slong skal bzang gi byin rten thang ka la'o/// / ༈ ston mchog rgyal dang chags bral dam pa'i chos// tshogs mchog dge 'dun bla med mchog gsum gyi// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yongs kyi gtso mchog dpal// deng 'dir brtse bas nyer dgongs gsan du gsol// bstan dang 'gro ba'i btsas gyur sprul pa'i sku// phan bde chos spyod bcu yi sgrub pa 'phel// rgyal ba'i ring lugs snying por sri zhu sogs// mthar phyin rtag par gegs med 'byung gyur cig / ces khams smyon sprul sku'i bzhed ltar si tus spel/// / ༈ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs mthus// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kyi// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan 'gro ba rnams// byang chub chen po thob phyir bsngo// lha rdog ngor spel/// / ༈ dkon mchog kun 'dus thugs rje'i 'od// snang byed dam pas deng 'di ru// sgrib gsum bag chags rtsad 'byin nas// byang grol lam bzang thob gyur cig / dpal sbas la'o/// / ༈ skyabs yul dam pa'i mthu dpal las// deng bzung byang chub ma thob bar// chos mthun dge ba'i sems ldan zhing*// grub pa'i rjes 'dzin sangs rgyas shog / sngags 'chang pad+ma rgyal po la spel/// / ༈ bde chen 'khor lor rtag bzhugs pa'i// gangs can mgon po karma ka /mi 'bral brtse bas rjes bzung ste// byang chub sems la dbang 'byor shog

/ dbang phyug ngor spel/// / ༈ nam mkha' mdzod bzhin longs spyod kyi// dbang phyug dbang sgyur rnam thos sras// re man+ta yi mthu dpal gyis// deng 'dir nyer 'tshe kun bral shog / a lhun ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun spyi gzugs pad+ma'i thugs rje'i 'od// deng 'dir 'gro blo'i rgyud kyi mun pa'i tshogs// pha mthar bskrad cing thar pa lam bzang gi /go 'phang dam pa tshegs med thob gyur cig / ces bka' brgyud chos 'phel ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun spyi mes pad+ma 'byung*// gang de'i thugs rje'i 'od snang gis// skal ldan nyon mongs sgrib tshogs rnams// drungs nas phyung ste rnam par grol// thar pa mchog gi lam bzang la// myur du 'god pa'i dpal thob cing*// 'gro ba'i ded dpon dam pa ru// dbugs dbyung yongs su thob par shog / dpon dge legs ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun phrin las mdzod 'dzin pa// pad 'byung sgyu 'phrul rol pa las// grub pa'i dbang phyug yongs kyi rgyan// rdo rje drag po'i zhabs pad+mo// bde chen 'khor lor 'bral med par// brtse bas rjes 'dzin thar mchog gi /lam bzang dam par myur ba ru// 'god pa'i skal bzang thob gyur cig / gdong nge ban chung ngor spel/// / ༈ sku gsum ston pa pad+ma 'byung*// gang gi thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings las// 'char ba'i phrin las rol pa mchog /'dren pa'i dpal gyur karma pa// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhabs// skye kun 'bral ba med pa dang*// nges 'byung byang chub sems ldan zhing*// sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin pa dang*// tshe dpal mtha' ru phyin pa dang*// rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin zhing*// sku bzhi'i go 'phang mthar phyin shog / dge slong karma mthar phyin ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed rmad byung bas// deng 'dir dge ba'i tshogs 'phel zhing*// rnam kun snying rjes rgyud brlan cing*// bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub gyur cig

/ sangs rgyas bla ma'i ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun spyi dpal pad 'byung gi// thugs rje'i 'jug pa zab mo yi// dam pa'i bdud rtsis 'tsho gyur te// sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon du shog / bla ma rig byed ngor spel/// / ༈ 'phags ma'i thugs rje'i gter chen las// byung ba'i 'od dkar bdud rtsi'i char// skal ldan rgyud la myur smin nas// tshe dang ye shes dpal thob shog / 'brong pa bla ma'i ngor spel/// / ༈ bla ma yi dam chos srung tshogs// rtsa gsum lha yi bden pa yis// deng 'dir mi nor dus rtag tu// bde ba'i dpal la spyod gyur cig / ces pa hor tshang ngor spel/// / ༈ skyabs gnas bslu med rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung*// thugs rje'i byin rlabs klong yangs dam pa nas// gzhan phan snying rje'i chu khur phreng ba yis// deng 'dir 'gyur med ye shes 'bras smin nas// sku bzhi'i go 'phang tshegs med nyid thob shog / skyid phug sprul sku'i bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ dbyings kyi khro rgyal he ru ka /pad+ma thod phreng byin rlabs kyis// deng 'dir nyer 'tshe kun bral nas// chos sku'i bdag nyid thob par shog / chos rgyal ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal ba'i yum gyur tā re mas// 'khor ba'i 'jigs las bsgral ba dang*// ye shes tshe dpal dbang 'byor zhing*// don gnyis lhun gyis grub gyur te// po ṭa la zhing dag pa'i gnas// tshegs med bde blag nyid bgrod nas// 'phags ma'i sras su dbang bskur ba'i// nges lam mthar thug thob par shog / dge slong karma chos 'dzin ngor spel/// / ༈ dpag yas rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed kyi// 'jug pa zab mo'i dpal dam pas// rang byung ye shes phyag rgya che'i// gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs gyur cig / gnas mdo bla chung bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun thugs rje'i 'od snang gis// deng 'dir sgrib pa'i mun tshogs rnams// rab bsal don dam de kho na'i// ngo bo mngon du gyur par shog

/ nus ldan nas bskul bzhin spel/// / ༈ bka' brgyud yongs kyi grub pa'i 'byung gnas mchog /bzhad pa rdo rje'i zhabs pad byang chub bar// 'bral med mchod do dus rnams kun tu skyongs// chos sku ye shes phyag rgya chen po yi// gnas lugs ngo bo 'khrul med nyid du rtogs// sgrib gnyis bag chags ma lus drungs phyung ste// yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i dpal thob nas// skye dgu'i ded dpon myur ba nyid 'grub shog / rtogs ldan chos dbang dang dar rgyas zung la spel/// / ༈ dpal ldan rigs kun ngo bo// drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen// mi 'bral snying gi dbus bzhugs// 'phags yul grub brnyes dbang phyug /sa ra ha zhes grags de// bde chen 'khor lor gus mchod// gdod nas lhan skyes sems nyid// gnas lugs gnyug ma chos sku'i// rang zhal mngon du gyur nas// sku bzhi'i go 'phang rin chen// bde blag nyid du thob cing*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dpal shog / ces pa'ang bstan 'dzin rin po ches bzhed ltar si tus spel/// / ༈ skyabs gsum kun 'dus bdag nyid karma pa// ma 'ongs bskal bzang rnam 'dren drug pa mchog /seng ge'i rnam 'phrul srid pa ji srid bar// 'gro ba'i skyabs su sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar// rim par byon pa rnams kyi thugs bskyed las// 'khrungs pa'i dge legs bye ba'i char rgyun gyis// deng 'dir nges 'byung thar pa'i zhing sa ru// bla med sku bzhi'i sa bon smin gyur te// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi lam la 'god gyur cig / ces pa 'di chags med rin po che'i mchog sprul karma bstan 'dzin phrin las nas bzhed ltar si tus spel// ༈ // rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po mchog /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// shrī tsit+ta badz+ra zhabs// 'bral med deng bzung byang chub bar// skye dang skye bar rjes 'dzin nas// dag pa'i zhing mchog pad+ma 'od// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi// zhal mthong bdud rtsi mnyes par shog

/ pad chos ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal dbang karma pa mchog gi// byin rlabs mthu yis rang byung gi / ye shes don dam de nyid kyi// gnas lugs ji bzhin nyid rtogs shog / theg 'phel ngor spel ba'o/// / ༈ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs kyi// char chen dbab ba'i mthu byin la// brten nas gdul bya'i thar lam ljon// bskyed bsring bla med 'bras thob shog / nyi ma'i ngor spel/// / ༈ 'chi med pad+mā ka ra yi// phrin las mi bzad 'od stong gis// bdud bzhi rtsad nas gzhom pa dang*// tshe dpal ye shes snang ba rgyas// rgyal bstan dri med rin po cher// gsos su smin pa'i bsam don kun// 'bad pa med par 'grub pa dang*// phyag rgya chen po thob gyur cig / sngags 'chang gur drag ngor spel/// / ༈ gangs can mgon po pad dkar can// dbyer med dpal ldan karma pa// chos kyi rgyal po srid zhi'i mgon// mchog gi thugs rje'i zla snang gis// ma rig sgrib pa'i mun bcom nas// yang dag don gyi lam mthong zhing*// sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob nas// 'gro ba'i ded dpon nyid gyur cig / karma nor bu'i ngor spel/// / ༈ skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid mchog /rgyal dbang karma pa zhes pa// nyi zla ltar grags gang de yis// skye nas skye bar rjes 'dzin shog / lhun grub ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed rol pa yis// deng 'dir nyer 'tshe las grol te// rnam mkhyen phyir mi ldog pa yi// go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig / chos dbyings ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal ba shāka thub thugs rje'i 'od// phyogs mthar khyab pa'i legs byas kyis// 'dul ba khrims ldan dge 'dun rnams// tshul khrims chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog /nyams med gong nas 'phel ba dang*// de mthus lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs// thams cad bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// mi rnams skye rga na 'chi yi// chu bo bzhi las grol ba dang*// byang grol lam la 'god gyur cig

/ dbu dpal ldan ngor spel/// / ༈ thugs rje thabs mkhas ston pa la// mi phyed gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bdag ni tshe rabs thams cad du// so thar bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas// ma nor sangs rgyas lam ston pa'i// bla ma mchog dang 'bral med cing*// tshe gcig dam chos phyag rgya che// chos sku'i rang zhal mngon gyur nas// mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams su// tshegs med bde blag bgrod gyur cig / dbu mdzad chos 'dzin ngor bris/// / ༈ rgyal dbang mtshor 'khrungs pad+ma 'byung*// mdo sngags gnyis ldan ston mchog la// gsol btab bden pas deng 'di ru// rgyal khams nad mug 'khrugs rtsod dang*// chos min bslu brid thar pa'i gegs// lus med rgyud bskul mda' lnga pa'i// dbang gis nyon mongs dug lnga rnams// ka dag dbyings su rang yal nas// ye shes sku ru lhun grub shog / blo gros ngor spel/// / ༈ 'dren pa mnyam med pad+ma 'byung*// gang de'i brtse chen thugs bskyed las// byung ba'i ye shes gaṅgā'i rgyun// rmad byung mi bzad 'babs pa'i mthus// bdag gzhan rgyud kyi las nyon las// bskyed pa'i sgrib bzhi dag gyur te// 'bras bu sku bzhi'i go 'phang mchog /tshegs med bde blag nyid thob shog /

sgrub brgyud ngor bris/// / ༈ ston pa rgyal dbang karma pa'i// thugs rje chen pos bzung ba'i mthus// kha ba can ljongs skye dgu'i tshogs// kun kyang byams pa'i sems ldan zhing*// rtag tu dam chos snying por bsgrub// de mthus rigs drug lam rgyud lngar// gnas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyang*// dge des bla med mchog thob shog / 'dus bzang ngor spel/// / ༈ mchog gsum bslu med ngo bo nyid// sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung*// rgyal ba gzhan las ches 'phags pa'i// mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rang bzhin can// gang des gzhan phan byang chub kyi// thugs bskyed lha lam yangs po nas// 'char ba'i sgyu 'phrul rnam rol pa// rgyu skar phreng tshogs lta bu dang*// de dbus phun tshogs lnga ldan gyi// yon tan cha shas yongs gang ba// srid 'di'i sgrib pa'i mun sel gnyen// nyi zla ltar grags karma pa// rgyal mchog bdud 'dul rdo rje yi// byin rlabs 'od dkar spel ba'i mthus// bdag gzhan rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa'i// bag nyal mun pa drungs phyung ste// tshe gcig phyag rgya chen po yi// go 'phang myur ba nyid thob ste// gru 'dzin zhing mchog der bgrod nas// bla med lung bstan thob gyur cig / dgon gsar karma tshe brtan ngor bgyis/// / ༈ rgyal kun skyed yum 'phags ma sgrol// gang de'i byin mthus tshe dpal rgyas// chos ldan bsam don 'bad med 'grub// rang byung ye shes ngo bo nyid// chos sku'i rang zhal mngon gyur te// po ṭa la yi zhing mchog tu// 'phags mas rjes 'dzin byang chub che'i// 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur par shog / karma chos dbyings ngor spel/// / ༈ de ltar dge tshogs nam mkha'i mtha' 'gengs pa'i// legs byas rgya mtsho'i rlabs las drangs pa yis// smon pa'i bsam don yid bzhin dbang rgyal ltar// 'bad med nyid du 'grub par gyis rlobs// rgyal bstan snying por gyur pa'i kaṃ tshang gi// nges don ring lugs phyogs mthar khyab yun gnas// de 'dzin rnams kyang phrin las rab 'phel zhing*// gang 'dir tshe bsod ye shes rab tu rgyas// skye kun snying po'i bstan pa spel nus pa'i// phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes rgyud smin nas// skal ldan 'gro sgrol mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi// go 'phang dam pa myur thob byin rlobs shog

/ lha bzo sprul sku pa'i bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ mchog gsum rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed kyi// dpag bsam ljon pa la brten nas// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs tsha gdung dag /byams pa'i bsil grib dam pa yis// bde nas bde bar 'tsho gyur cig /nam yang skye ba brgyud ma ru// rgyal dbang karma pa de yis// rjes 'dzin mya ngan 'das thob shog / bde dga'i ngor spel/// / ༈ gangs can lha gcig spyan ras gzigs// tha mi dad pa karma pa// phyogs dus rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gyi// yon tan 'dzin la dbang sgyur ba'i// mgon des skye dang skye ba nas// thugs rjes 'bral med skyong ba dang*// chos ldan dpal 'byor lhun grub cing*// mthar thug byang grol lam 'god shog / rgya mtsho'i ngor spel/// / ༈ rtsa gsum thugs rje'i 'od snang gis// deng 'dir nyes gsum mun gzhom nas// sgo gsum sgrib tshogs rtsad 'byin cing*// mthar thug sku gsum yongs thob shog / ces pa'am dbang 'dzin ngor spel/// / ༈ gangs can lha gcig pad+ma can// gang gi byang chub rlabs chen gyis// rigs drug sems can sdug bsngal las// sgrol te lam bzang 'god gyur cig / 'jang tshe dbang mgon pos bskul bzhin spel/// / ༈ bde chen zhing mgon 'chi med tshe mchog bdag /bcom ldan mgon po tshe 'od dpag med la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul nongs 'chags yi rang ngo*// 'gro ba'i don bskul gsol 'debs dge tshogs kun// bdag gzhan thar pa'i grong mchog nyams dga' bar// 'jug pa'i phyir bsngo skye dang skye ba nas// phyin drug dang ldan don la rab gnas te// skye rga na 'chi'i 'jigs las grol bar shog /sbyin pa'i stobs rdzogs rnam thos sras po yi// 'dod dgu'i dpag bsam myur du smin pa dang*// nyer 'tshe las gyur mi mthun sde ris bcas// tshar gcod rjes 'dzin phrin las mdzad du gsol// lha bris tshe dbang dar rgyas ngor spel/// / ༈

kye ma/ rnam par smin pa'i las dbang drag bo yis// gang zhig dus 'dir der snang byol song lus// bdag gis bzung dang ma bzung ji snyed pa// kun kyang mi rtag chu bur yal ma thag /bde ba can zhes snang mtha'i zhing khams su// brdzus te skyes nas ston mchog zhal mthong shog /de ma thob bar skye dang tshe rabs su// bde dga'i dpal spyod dal 'byor rten bzang thob// sgrub brgyud rin chen bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas// rnam dag bslab pa gsum gyi don spyod cing*// bder gshegs snying po'i rang zhal mngon sum mthong*// mtha' klas sems can 'dren pa'i gnyen gyur cig /de ltar skyabs yul kun 'dus dam pa'i mgon// o rgyan slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung*// mchog gi brtse chen thugs bskyed rgya tsho las// byin rlabs dgos 'byung nor bu dpag bsam dbang*// bdag sogs mos pas gsol btab ji bzhin du// de bzhin thogs med lhun gyis grub pa dang*// nges gsang rdo rje snying po'i ring lugs gang*// mtha' klas kun tu khyab pa'i rgyur gyur cig / ces bdag tu bzung dang ma bzung ba'i dud 'gro'i rigs spyi dang bye brag rnams kyis mtshon 'gro drug phan bde'i dga' ston spel bar smon lam 'di bzhin si tu pa pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ sras bcas rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// dbyer med pad+ma thod phreng gi// byin mthus gu ru dz+nyā na nyid// gsang gsum zla ba cha gang bzhin// mi mthun nyes pa'i chu 'dzin zhi// gdul bya'i rdzing bu rnyogs bral bar// dam chos bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs te// thar lam ljon shing 'khrungs par shog / ces gcod pa ye shes dgongs bzhed ltar spel pa'o/// / ༈ 'jig rten dbang phyug pad dkar 'chang dbang po// sgrub brgyud gtsug rgyan dpal ldan karma pa'i// phrin las gru chen 'degs pa'i smon lam can// karma si tu 'di bzung byang chub bar// rtag tu 'bral med chos mthun bsam 'grub cing*// bskal bzang rnam 'dren lnga pa'i zhabs pad+mor// bsnyen nas 'dus pa dang por dbugs dbyung ste// bla med rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu mngon gyur shog

/ lha bzo sprul sku'i bzhed ltar mtshur phur spel ba'o/// / ༈ bcom ldan rgyal ba yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas// bde gshegs sman gyi bla ma bai ḍūr+ya'i// 'od kyi snang ba dpag med mchog de yi// sngon gyi smon lam chen po de bzhin tu// gang 'dir yang ni phan bde nyer 'tsho'i gzhi// gso ba rig pa'i brgyud 'dzin gang su dag /de rnams kyi ni rig pa'i blo gros kyi// nyin byed 'od kyi snang ba spro bzhin nas// skye 'gro'i 'byung 'dus 'khrugs pa'i khri mun bcom// 'chi med mchog gi pad tshal rtsa ba brtan// dpal 'byor bzang po'i lo 'dab kun tu rgyas// mthar thug zhing khams dam par bgrod gyur cig / ces gar dbang rin po ches gsung ngor si tu pas dpal spungs yang dben du bris/// / ༈ mchog gsum thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings dam pa nas// rmad byung phrin las 'od stong kun tu gsal// 'gro tshogs las nyon sgrib mun drwa ba bsal// yang dag ye shes pad+mo rab rgyas shog /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba ji snyed pa// dus gsum rgyal ba'i drung du mchod cing 'bul// dus gsum sems can yongs kyi don du bsngo// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mnga' dbang thob par shog /bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa'i zhing khams su// nam zhig mi rtag chu bur yal ma thag /skye gzhan ma chod nub phyogs dag zhing du// brdzus te skyes nas ston mchog bcom ldan 'das// 'dzam gling sprul sku'i bkod pas rnam rol ni// mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho'i dpal zhes pa// 'od snang mtha' yas dpag med rgyal po ste// mchog gi zhal mthong byang chub dbugs 'byin zhing*// bla med lung bstan pa yang thob par shog /de ltar smon pa'i 'dod don yongs grub pa'i// rtsa gsum ngo bo dpal ldan karma pa// mgon des tshad med dam bca'i khur zab mos// deng 'dir ji bzhin don kun smin gyur cig / ces pa rtogs ldan sgrub brgyud kyis bskul bzhin si tu pas yang dben sgrub brgyud dar rgyas gling du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ su dza ya/// /

༈ rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi dpal mchog /he ru ka dpal 'khor los sgyur// rig 'dzin yongs gtso rgyal ba'i sras// tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs pad+mo// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bsnyen cing rdo rje bzhi'i// byin rlabs sku bzhi'i 'bras thob nas// de mthus bstan 'gro'i gsos gyur shog / ces pa'ang rgyal rigs sbas pa'i ngang tshul gyi brtul zhugs 'chang ba sgrub pa ba shes rab ngor spel/// / ༈ bla med bla mar gyur pa karma ka'i// byin rlabs 'od brgya'i snang bas deng 'di ru// bskal mun bsags pa'i sgrib mun bag chags rnams// myur du gzhil te yang dag ye shes kyi// pad tshal chen po rab tu grol gyur cig /de las byung ba'i nyams len gdams pa'i bcud// 'gro kun bung ba dmus long tshogs ji snyed// rang byung lhan skyes brjod med rtogs gyur cig / rang bzhin ngor spel/// / ༈ lha mi'i ston mchog bla na med// bder gshegs kun mkhyen shākya'i tog /'dren pa mnyam med gang de la// lus dang longs spyod dus gsum gyi// dge tshogs gcig tu bsdus nas ni// rgyal ba khyod la 'bul bar bgyi// srid pa'i mig gcig bla na med// rigs kun khyab bdag karma ka /bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan// phrin las snang ba rgyas gyur nas// sgrub brgyud rin chen dar zhing rgyas// rigs drug 'khor ba dong sprugs shog /bcom ldan 'das ma tut+tā re'i// byin rlabs 'od dkar bdud rtsi yis// tshe dpal bsod nams longs spyod 'phel// don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas shog / ces ya kre'i bu mo lnga la smon lam du spel/// / ༈ dkon mchog rtsa gsum kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung*// gang gi byin rlabs rgyud la sim pa'i mthus// chos mthun bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// gnas lugs zab don mngon gyur sangs rgyas shog / ces pa'ang dbon sprul karma rab sgrub bzhed ngor dge// /

༈ yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// nus mthu byin rlabs gter chen pos// deng 'dir nyer 'tshe kun bral zhing*// tshe dpal ye shes dbang 'byor ba'i// rmad byung 'dod don yongs grub nas// 'dus byas snang ba nub ma thag /bde ldan bkod pa'i zhing bgrod nas// rgyal ba'i zhal mthong dbugs dbyung shog / ces rgya rdo rje dbang phyug la spel/// / ༈ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter chen 'jig rten mgon// dbyer med rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhabs// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i rjes bzung pad+ma'i gnyen// nyin byed dbang po'i rgyal bstan gsal la 'dud// rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// snying po don gyi brgyud pa'i gdams zab rgyun// lhan skyes ye shes rang byung ngo bo nyid// don dam chos sku'i gnas lugs ma bcos ngang*// 'khrul med lta ba'i gdeng ldan zhen med kyi// sgom pa 'dzin med de yi ngang nyid las// blang dor bral ba'i spyod pa skyong bzhin du// 'bras bu chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par shog /dus gsum dge tshogs bsags pa'i legs byas kyis// bla ma'i zhabs brtan rgyal bstan 'phel yun gnas// dge 'dun sde rgyas bdag dang bdag 'brel ba'i// thog med dus nas pha mar gyur pa yi// rigs drug sems can 'khor ba'i duḥkha las// sgrol nas byang chub snying po mngon gyur shog /de ma thob bar tshe rabs thams cad du// sdug bsngal ming med dga' bdes 'tsho bzhin par// chos min bshes bral chos bzhin spyod 'jug nas// mthar thug bla med rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog / ces 'brug mtsho mjug sprul sku kar brgyud bstan 'dzin lhun grub kyi bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya'i rgyal// des gsung theg pa gsum gyi dam pa'i chos// nyan thos bcu drug la sogs dge 'dun te// bla med mchog gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu// lung dang rtogs ba'i bstan pa rin po che// yun gnas de 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs brtan zhing*// rdzogs ldan dge ba'i lang tsho rgyas gyur cig

/khyad par rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag che// skyes mchog mar pa'i bka' brgyud ya bzhi dang*// zung brgyad khyad par sgrub brgyud mthar thug pa// karma kaṃ tshang zhes grags snying po'i bstan// sprin bral mkha' la nyi 'od 'bum brdal bzhin// 'dzam gling mtha' dbus khyab ba'i lhag bsam gyi// mthun rkyen mtha' dag 'bad med yongs grub nas// bkra shis dge ba'i dpal dang ldan gyur cig / ces dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i gdan sa 'og ma shar kaṃ po gangs ra dang rjes su 'brel ba'i kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod gnyis par grags pa 'dob spang phug 'brug rje dar rgyas gling pa'i 'dus sde rnams kyi bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ skyabs gsum kun 'dus dpal ldan karma ka /yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i byin rlabs kyi// chu 'dzin 'thug por gtibs las mchog thun dang*// las bzhi'i gru char 'bebs pas dad gsum gyi// zhing sar bde legs 'bras bzang yongs smin pas// gnas skabs mthar thug dgos dgu 'grub pa dang*// rang rig bcos min lhan skyes phyag rgya che// gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings mngon par byang chub shog / 'brug rje gling dge slong dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i ngor spel/// / ༈ dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod na// rje rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// bskal bzang gi 'dren pa 'khor ba 'jig /rnam 'phrul mchog rdo rje rgyal po yi// byin rlabs kyi nyin byed 'bum brdal bas// deng 'di ru skal ldan pad+ma'i tshal// don gnyis kyi 'dab stong rgyas ba dang*// byang chub kyi lo 'dab g.yo bzhin par// rang gzhan kun thar pa'i lam bkod pa'i// sku lnga yi bdag nyid mchog thob shog / ces 'dab chags ne tso'i 'dod ngor spel bar bya ba'i chos so/// / ༈ sku gsum bdag nyid 'chi med pad+ma 'byung*// lnga bdo'i dus 'dir rgyal ba gzhan kun las// ches cher 'phags pa'i thugs rje rmad byung bar// rnam kun gsol ba btab ba'i mthu las ni// nam zhig sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor yal ba'i tshe// dag pa mkha' spyod o rgyan zhing dam pa// pad+ma 'od du myur bar bgrod nas su// rig 'dzin slob dpon chen po'i zhal mthong nas// gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig la gnas te// bla na med pa'i lung bstan thob par shog

/de ltar smon pa yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phyir// mchog gsum rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i bden pa dang*// chos dbyings bsam mi khyab pa'i bden pa yis// ji bzhin myur ba nyid du 'grub gyur cig / ces pa'ang spong ba pa karma dharma shrī'i ngor si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos dpal ri rtse nas spel ba'o/// /

༈ hrīḥ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sku// bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa'i zhing bdag mchog /ston pa sangs rgyas 'od snang mtha' yas la// bdag dang 'gro kun phyag 'tshal mchod cing bshags// rjes su yi rangs bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo// a 'thas sgyu ma'i lus rten bor ma thag /bcom ldan 'od dpag med kyi gnas dam pa// phun tshogs lnga ldan zhing khams dam pa ru// brdzus skyes rgyal ba'i zhal mthong bla med kyi// lung bstan mchog thob 'gro ba'i ded dpon du// gyur te khams gsum sgrol ba'i dpal du shog / ces dad nor gyis mngon par mdzes pa rgya bkra shis dbang phyug dang dar rgyas zung gi ngor spel ba dza yan+tu/// / ༈ skyabs gsum ngo bo o rgyan rje// karma pa yi thugs rje'i mthus// gdod nas rang byung sems nyid 'di// gzhi med rtsa bral don rtogs shing*// spros bral ye shes chos kyi sku// phyag rgya chen po 'grub gyur nas// zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang gi// go 'phang dam pa myur thob shog / ces pa'ang zab mo'i rnal 'byor ras chung sprul nas bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun 'dus pa pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje can// gang khyod snying gi pad+mor rtag bzhugs nas// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad pa// bla med gsang chen theg pa'i don rtogs shing*// srid pa'i 'jigs tshogs ma lus kun sgrol nas// gdod ma'i sangs rgyas sa la 'god gyur cig / ces rdo rje drag po'i gsol 'debs 'di bzhin cog ro sprul sku'i bzhed ltar bris pa dza ya/// / ༈ rigs drug sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// rtsad 'byin thugs rje'i 'od dkar can// spyan ras gzigs kyis tshe rabs su// rjes 'dzin chos dang dpal 'byor gyi// snang bas 'tsho zhing po ṭa la'i// zhing mchog dam par spyod gyur cig// /

༈ pad+ma'i byin rlabs rdo rje rtse brgya pas// log phyogs bdud rigs dpung gzhom mchog thun gyi// dngos grub dam pa bde blag nyid thob nas// mthar thug sku lnga'i bdag nyid thob par shog // ༈ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang byang sems thugs rje'i 'phrul// deng 'dir las nyon sgrib gnyis bag chags kyi// drwa ba stug po rtsad nas gzhom pa dang*// yang dag legs pa'i lam bzang thob gyur cig// / ༈ mchog gsum rgya mtsho'i bde legs kyis// gang zhig yid la 'dod 'jo ba'i// chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa dang*// ye shes chen po mngon gyur shog// / ༈ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa// mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang chen gyi// mtshan dpe 'od zer stong 'phro bas// mi mthun sgrib gnyis ma lus zhi// tshe dpal don gnyis lhun gyis grub// rang byung ye shes don rtogs shog / ces rab snang ngor spel/// / ༈ bla med bla ma karma pa// bcu gsum phreng ba rim byon las// mtshungs med bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang*// 'bral med bde chen 'khor lo ru// rtag par rigs dkyil bdag por bzhugs// byin rlabs dngos grub yongs smin nas// gnas skabs bsam don chos bzhin 'grub// bar chad bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal// rnam grol thar pa byang chub kyi// go 'phang bde blag nyid thob shog / ces bla ma phrin las rab rgyas kyi thugs bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ phyogs bcu dus gsum zhing khams rab 'byams na// rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i tshogs// ma lus ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag la// phyag 'tshal mi dge nongs ba'i las rnams bshags// bla med byang grol go 'phang rin po che// bde blag nyid du thob pa'i phyir du bsngo// skye nas skye bar dam pas rjes bzung zhing*// chos spyod bcu yi sgrub pa mthar phyin shog / bstan dar ngor spel/// / ༈ gangs can skye dgu'i 'dren pa dpal chen po// rgyal ba mchog dngos khyab bdag karma ka

/snyan pa'i ba dan srid gsum kun khyab pa'i// bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// gsang sngags theg pa'i ston pa bla na med// rdo rje slob dpon tsit+ta badz+ra zhabs// spyi bos gus mchod 'di nas byang chen bar// rjes su 'dzin cing dam chos snying po yi// sgor zhugs rgyal bstan rin chen sri zhu dang*// ma gyur mkha' mnyam rdzogs sangs rgyas thob pa'i// grub pa rnam gnyis mthar phyin lhun grub shog / ces pa'ang las rdor kar brgyud rab rgyas ngor spel/// / ༈ skye ba kun tu ma nor lam ston pa'i// rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor dbang phyug mchog /'bral med rgyal bstan dri med rin po cher// gces spras 'dzin pa'i mthu dbang thob par shog// / ༈ dkon mchog rnam gsum thugs rje yis// deng 'dir dkar po dge ba'i chos// lhun gyis grub pa'i yon tan rdzogs// mthar thug chos kyi sku thob shog / dbon dpal lu'i ngor spel/// / ༈ pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs rje'i 'od// snang bas deng 'dir bkra shis pa'i// bde legs dpal dang 'byor pa yis// kun nas kun tu dge gyur cig// / ༈ gru 'dzin phreng ba rim byon pa'i// karma pa zhes nyi zla ltar// grags de'i byin mthus 'gro ba kun// bde chen thar pa'i snang byed shog / bstan 'dzin nor bu'i ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun 'dus gzugs pad+ma 'byung*// gang de'i bla med byin rlabs kyis// deng 'dir tshe dpal yon tan rgyas// lhan skyes ye shes chos kyi sku'i// gnas lugs mngon gyur rdzogs sangs rgyas// go 'phang bde blag nyid thob nas// 'khor ba srid pa'i rgya mtsho las// sgrol ba'i mgon dang gnyen gyur cig / ces pa'ang sgrub pa gzi brjid ngor spel/// / ༈ srid zhi'i dpal yon karma pa// rgyal kun phrin las 'dzin pa'i bdag /bcu gsum bdud 'dul rdo rje yis// skye dang tshe rabs rjes 'dzin shog

/ chos dbyings ngor spel/// / ༈ 'chi med dpal kun ster ba'i mgon// o rgyan chen po'i byin rlabs char// deng 'dir dad pa'i zhing sa ru// rnam dag 'bras bu bskyed bsring shog// / ༈ tshad med snying rje'i dbang phyug mchog /dngos snang bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang*// gang des skye dang tshe rabs kun// rjes bzung byang chub lam 'god shog / karma bzang skyod ngor spel/// / ༈ sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung*// dbyer med bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon// rdo rje drag po'i thugs rje'i 'od// snang bas deng bzung byang chub bar// rjes bzung chos mthun bsam pa 'grub// chos min log rtog dug lnga yi// g.yul las rnam rgyal bde ba che// pad+ma 'od zhing bgrod nus shog / skyabs rje 'dzi sgar rin po che'i gsol smon 'di bzhin stong nag yang dag ched du spel/// / ༈ stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag dus gsum rgyal dang sras// nyan thos gnas brtan dgra bcom che rnams dang*// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas o rgyan rje// nges don mthar thug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las dbang bsgyur ba// karma pa zhes nyi ltar rab gsal ba'i// rje btsun bdud las rnam par rgyal ba de'i// thugs bskyed zab mo'i 'jug ngogs mtha' yas par// don gnyis nor bu'i dpal la dbang 'byor phyir// gzhan phan sems bskyed dam bca'i dri bzhon gyis// bskul te lhag bsam gru rdzings la brten nas// snying po'i ring lugs phyogs mthar spel byed pa'i// lhun grub yid la 'dod 'jo'i dge legs stsol// dus kyis bslad pa'i gnyis 'thung lta ba'i lam// g.yang sa chen po dag las sgrol nas su// thar pa mchog gi zhing der bgrod par shog / 'brong pa bla ma karma yon tan lhun grub nas bskul bzhin spel ba bstan pa dar rgyas su gyur cig /dzayan+tu/// / ༈ stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag de bzhin gshegs// shākya seng ge'i zhal skyin mchog

/dpal ldan karma pa zhes pa'i// mtshan snyan nyi zla ltar gsal ba'i// skyes rabs phreng ba bcu gsum pa// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje yis// 'gro rgyud ma rig las nyon gyis// 'thums byed mun pa'i drwa ba rnams// ye shes chen po'i gzi yis bcom// rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa yi// don dam de nyid gnas mthong shog / karma ye shes ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal yum 'phags ma tshe sbyin dpal// gter 'dzin dbang mo'i thugs bskyed mthus// deng 'dir zag bcas dngos kun gyi// dpal 'byor rab rgyas zag med ni// 'chi med mchog grub gnyug ma'i sems// spros bral lhan skyes myur rtogs shog / nyi ma'i ngor spel/// / ༈ tshad med thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung*// gang de'i gsang gsum ye shes kyi// byin rlabs dbang bzhi mchog thob shog /de ltar smin pa'i dge legs kyi// bsam don lhun grub dpal dang 'byor// snyan grags chos srid dbang thang rgyas// nyer 'tshe kun bral bde ldan shog /de ltar bden pa'i byin rlabs gang*// dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i bden stobs kyis// ji bzhin yongs grub sku bzhi yi// go 'phang mchog la 'god gyur cig / gu ru bstan skyong bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ gru 'dzin phreng ba 'dzin pa'i mchog /rgyal mchog stobs bcu mnga' brnyes pa// mā ra da ma ka badz+ra// deng 'dir myang 'das chen po'i bar// 'bral med thugs rjes nyer bzung nas// rang rig ye shes don dam pa'i// gnas lugs gnyug ma chos kyi sku'i// ngo bo ji bzhin mthong gyur cig / blo gros ngor spel/// / ༈ rigs bdag snang mtha' 'od dpag med// dbyer med chos grub rgya mtsho mchog /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med cing*// mthar thug gdod ma'i gnas lugs mchog /ji ltar nyid du tshegs med mthong*// zung 'jug sku dang ye shes kyi// bdag nyid chen por dbang 'byor nas// 'gro sgrol sprul bsgyur ston nus shog

/ karma bsam 'grub ngor spel/// / ༈ o rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung*// mchog gi gsang gsum ye shes kyi// nyi 'od 'bum 'phro'i mthu dpal las// gdul bya skal ldan pad+mo'i tshal// thar pa'i lam bzang 'dab brgya bzhad// tshe bsod 'byor dang grags pa yi// lo 'dab phyogs kun khyab pa dang*// ka dag lhun grub thod rgal gyi// gzhi lam 'bras bu yongs smin nas// sku lnga'i bdag nyid chen po mchog /thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang dang*// dgongs pa mnyam nyid klong yangs su// gnyis med sprul bsgyur du ma yis/ mtha' yas 'gro ba sgrol bar shog / tshe 'bar ngor spel/// / ༈ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bo nyid// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug khyab bdag rigs kun gtso// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje gar gyi dbang*// chos grub rgya mtsho dam chos nyi ma'i sde// rdo rje drag po tshe dbang dpal dar sogs// grub pa mchog ster rtsa brgyud bla ma la// bdag lus gaṅgā'i bye snyed lus sprul te// phyag 'tshal mchod cing nyes bshags yi rang ngo*// chos ston bzhugs gsol dus gsum dge tshogs rnams// mkha' khyab 'gro ba byang chub thob phyir bsngo// thar pa'i lam ston 'dren pa mchog rnams kyi// byin rlabs dbang bzhis bdag rgyud smin gyur cig / ces pa'ang rtogs ldan rab 'byor ngor spel/// / ༈ ston pa mtshungs med dpal ldan karma pa// gu ru'i rnam 'phrul tshe dbang nor bu dang*// dbyer med rdo rje gtsug lag dga' ba'i dbang// h+ya gri wa tsit+ta badz+ra zhabs// karma rnam rgyal rdo rje rab brtan sogs// byang grol lam gyi 'dren pa mchog rnams la// bdag lus zhing rdul sprul nas phyag 'tshal lo// deng bzung bla med snying por mchis kyi bar// bslab gsum dang ldan gdams ba'i bcud thob nas// sa dang lam gyi yon tan ma lus rdzogs// bde ldan zhing gi mgon po'i zhal mthong nas// 'gro ba'i ded dpon nyid du 'gyur bar shog

/ karma brtson 'grus kyi 'dod don bzhin spel/// / ༈ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i dpal// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug mi la ras// gang der gsol btab smin pa'i mthus// rang byung rig pa'i ye shes kyi// ngo bo gcer mthong phyag rgya che'i// go 'phang gegs med nyid thob nas// ma rnams 'khor ba'i gcong rong las// 'dren pa'i mgon du deng gyur cig / ces sgrub pa chos dbang phun tshogs ngor spel/// / ༈ dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid// o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma kā ra yi// thugs rje'i bden pas deng 'dir skal ldan gyi// sgrib gnyis bag chags mun pa drungs phyung nas// sa lam yon tan gong du rab gsal ba'i// bla med mchog gi snang bas skyong gyur cig / ces pa'ang rtogs ldan zung gi ngor spel/// / ༈ ston mchog shākya'i rgyal po dang*// nyan thos gnas brtan byang sems tshogs// rig 'dzin grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur// 'chi med pad+mā ka ra dang*// gsar rnying rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs// rgyud sde bzhi 'brel yi dam lha// dpa' bo ḍā ki ye shes dang*// las grub 'jig rten chos skyong tshogs// brtse bas 'dir dgongs rgyal ba'i bstan// phyogs kun khyab cing nub med pa// srid mthar gnas par byin gyis rlobs// bdud rigs log phyogs bslad pa yi// chos min chos ltar bcos pa rnams// zhi zhing yang dag nges pa'i lam// bla med 'od gsal phyag rdzogs kyi// zung 'jug bstan pa dar rgyas shog / tshogs gnyis ngor spel/// / ༈ bcom ldan bder gshegs don kun grub// shākya'i rgyal dang mtsho skyes kyi// sangs rgyas pad+ma kā ra yi// thugs rje'i gar gyi sgyu 'phrul ba// bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal thabs mchog /dri med rdo rje snying po yi// rgyal mtshan grags dkar bsgrengs pa'i bdag /mthon mthing cod pan 'chang ba po// dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa nas// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang*// bcu gsum yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng*// chu zla'i gar gyi rol pa yis// skye dgu'i ngan song mun gzhom zhing// bla med ye shes snang ba che// yang dag rang byung rig stong pa// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug go 'phang mchog
