/dngos grub char rgyun bsil ba'i bdag /thugs rje phan bde'i rang bzhin gyi// phun tshogs dpal yon rab rgyas shing*// ring lugs nyin mor byed pa'i 'od// rab gsal phyogs der rgud pa'i mun// drwa ba gtan bcom mthar thug tu// byang chen lam mchog dam pa ru// mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas par shog / ces li yul lcang ra smug po'i ljongs su bka' brgyud bstan pa'i gsal byed bla ma sprul sku rnam rgyal gyis bskul ltar spel/// / ༈ pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs rje'i 'od// snang bas deng 'dir bkra shis pa'i// bde legs dpal dang 'byor ba yis// kun nas kun tu dge gyur cig /gru 'dzin phreng ba rim byon pa'i// karma pa zhes nyi zla ltar// grags de'i byin mthus 'gro ba kun// bde chen thar pa'i snang byed shog / bstan 'dzin nor bu'i ngor spel/// / ༈ mchog gsum gsang gsum rten mchog gi// bsti gnas 'og min karma yi// thugs rjes deng 'dir 'gro ba kun// rdo rje 'chang gi sku thob shog// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i rang gzugs mchog /stobs bcu mnga' ba shākya thub pa'i dbang*// sku gsum bdag nyid sangs rgyas gnyis pa mchog /o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas dang*// gter chen brgya rtsa gter phran stong rtsa gnyis// gsar rnying brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa dang*// bde dgyes gsang 'dus rgyud sde bzhir 'brel ba'i// yi dam rab 'byams dpa' bo ḍā ki dang*// ber can phyag bzhi ma ning rang byung rgyal// pho rgyud mo rgyud ye shes las 'jig rten// srung ma dam can ma lus ji snyed pa// deng 'dir thugs rje chen pos brtser dgongs la// chos mthun bsam pa lhun grub tshe mthar phyin// dpal dang grags spel rnam kun bkra shis shing*// snang zhing srid pa'i sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs// kun kyang byams pa'i sems ldan dkar phyogs skyong*// mthun rkyen grub pa'i grogs su 'gyur pa dang*// bdud dang bdud kyi rigs gyur nyer 'tshe'i rigs// rang sar rang grol ka dag klong yangs su// mkha' la sprin thim bzhin du dag gyur cig
/de ltar mchog gsum rtsa gsum rin po che// bden gsung bden grub rnams kyi mthu dpal gyis// lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis rab rgyas shog /

ces bzo rigs gnas mdo bla ma'i bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ gsang sngags theg pa'i mthar thug zab mo'i lam// bskyed rdzogs smin grol gdams pa'i gter mdzod mchog /sku gsum bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// zag med 'od gsal dbang bsgyur myang ban cher// dbang bskur bka' gtad lung bstan mtshams sbyar nas// ham phrang lcags kyi sgo mor rgya yis btab// slar yang smon lam mthu yis sprul pa'i sku// o rgyan las 'phro gling pas spyan drangs pa'i// yang zab bla med dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi// grol byed khrid rim rig 'dzin 'khor los sgyur// tshe dbang nor bu'i dpal gyi zhal bdud rtsi// bstan 'gro rgud pa'i tsha gdung gzhil slad du// 'phrul gyi spar yig ngogs su spel ba'i mthus// mkha' khyab sems can phra rab rdul gyi grangs// yang dag lta ba 'khrul med nyid du rtogs// spros bral ye shes chos kyi sku thob shog / ces dbon sprul karma rat+nas yang zab khrid rim spar du bzhengs skabs gang de'i bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa// mtsho skyes pad 'byung rdo rje 'chang*// gang des skye dang tshe rabs kun// rjes bzung yang dag zab mo'i lam// bgegs med myur du bgrod gyur nas// 'khor 'das ye grol mnyam nyid klong*// rang rig ye shes chos kyi sku// kun tu bzang dang dbyer med shog / lho chung tshang dam pa'i bla mchan karma tshe brtan dpal dbang nas bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ sku gsum bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das// lung rtogs yon tan dam pa'i chos// rig grol 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sde// skyabs gnas gzhar yang bslu med pa// mchog gi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char// bsnyil ba'i legs byas dge legs kyis// deng 'dir thar pa'i sa bon gyi// skyed bsring bla med sangs rgyas shog / ri pa bla ma karma kun bzang nas bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sku// o rgyan chen po'i gsang gsum gyi// yon tan mtha' klas thugs rje'i mthus// bsam don chos bzhin yongs 'grub shog

/tshe dpal ye shes 'byor ba rgyas// bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal sgrib gnyis byang*// bsod nams tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas// thar pa'i go 'phang 'god nus shog / ces pa ban chen bla ma'i ngor spel/// / ༈ dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i mthu dpal gyi// chos ldan bsam don myur 'grub cing*// yang dag bde chen mchog gi lam// ma nor gsal bar mthong gyur nas// bla med sku lnga'i go 'phang la// bde blag nyid du bgrod par shog / ces mgon khang pa'i ngor spel/// / ༈ mnyam med don kun yongs grub pa// shākya'i rgyal dang mtsho skyes kyi// bla ma pad 'byung rdo rje 'chang*// gang gi byin rlabs mkha' dbyings las// thugs rjes ma rig mun sel ba'i// nyin byed 'od stong phyogs mthar 'phro// 'gro ba kun mkhyen rgyal ba yi// zhing khams pad+mo'i dga' tshal rgyas// bla med rang byung ye shes kyi// 'bras bu mngon par byang chub che'i// go 'phang yongs thob sangs rgyas shog / ces pa'ang dge slong tshul khrims dang dpal 'byor bcas kyi ngor spel/// / ༈ mgon po mnyam med thugs rje can// rlabs chen 'gro ba'i don spyod pa'i// phrin las gzhan dring mi 'jog pa// mtsho skyes pad+mā ka ra yi// byin mthus mkha' dbyings klong yangs nas// dngos grub 'od stong rab gsal bas// 'gro rgyud sgrib gnyis mun pa gzhom// rnam grol rang byung ye shes kyi// pad tshal ches cher rgod gyur te// sku bzhi bla med 'bras bu mchog /chags med thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes lha bris pa dbang rgyal ngor spel/ ༈ /// pad+mā ka ra'i thugs rje'i 'od// deng 'dir snang ba'i byin rlabs kyis// yang dag snang ba'i lam gsal nas// bde chen ye shes rab rgyas shog / thar pa'i ngor spel/// / ༈ ār+ya tā re yum gyur ma'i// thugs rje'i 'od dkar bsil rgyun gyis// srid 'gro'i nyon mongs gdung bcil nas// don gnyis kun+da'i tshal rgyas shog

/ a ba'i ngor spel/ ༈ /// rab 'byams mtha' klas bde bar gshegs kun gyi// thugs rje'i gong bu gcig bsdus 'jig rten mgon// dngos snang mi bskyod rigs kyi cod pan can// karma pa mchog bdud 'dul rdo rje yis// rnam kun rjes bzung dbang bzhi yongs thob nas// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid chen por dbang gyur shog / karma yid 'ong ngor spel/// / ༈ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ thugs rje bla med bcom ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas// lung rtogs zhi ba chags bral chos kyi mchog /rnam dag bslab gsum 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sde// deng 'dir bden 'grub shis pa'i dpal kun stsol// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mthu byin ma lus pa'i// gsang gsum yon tan bye bas mngon mtho ba// 'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na pad dkar 'chang*// gangs can ljongs 'dir mthon mthing cod pan 'chang*/ / skyes rabs phreng ba tshar du dngar ba las// bcu gsum bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje 'chang*// gang de'i gsung gsang dad dang nges pa'i don// dam chos nor bu rin chen 'dod 'jo'i gter// chu zla'i gar gyi rol rtsed ji bzhin par// bstan dang 'gro ba'i gsos su 'gyur ba'i ched// rnam dpyod blo gros thogs med shes rab kyi// zab mo'i gnas la gzigs pa'i spyan yangs pa/ dbon sprul karma rat+na'i thugs bskyed kyi// legs byas khyung sngon skyes kyis drangs nas su// rgyal ba'i bka' mchog nyin mor byed pa yis// mos ldan pad+ma'i dga' tshal bzhad pa'i phyir// dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling nyid du/ spar du bkod pa'i dge 'bras gang thob des// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun 'dus pa 'phel// 'gro rnams rdzogs ldan dpal la longs spyod cing*// rang byung gdod ma'i gnas lugs mngon gyur nas// byang chub chen por rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog / ces pa'ang gang de'i thugs bzhed ltar si tu pas spel ba dza yan+tu/// /

༈ na ma shrī gu ra we/ dus gsum rnam 'dren grub pa'i rgyan gcig bu// karma pa mchog skyes rabs phreng ba las// bcu gsum 'dud 'dul rdo rje 'chang chen po// 'di nas byang chub bar du spyi bos mchod// ma rig 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal me 'obs las// thar bar 'dod pa'i blo ldan mgon med bdag /mgon khyod thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'od dkar gyi// snang ba'i zer ma bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang pos// rang rgyud yongs su smin par byin gyis rlobs// gdod nas dri bral bde ba'i rang bzhin can// bla med theg pa mchog gi yang snying don// zab gsang rdo rje'i gnad kyi lam bzang po// mos gus dad pa'i rtsal shugs la brten nas// rang byung ye shes ngo bo lhun gyis grub// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rgyud la smin par shog /bdag gi dge tshogs chu rgyun ji snyed pa// 'gro rnams myang 'das rgya mtshor 'jug phyir bsngo// 'khor gsum mi dmigs smon lam mthu yis ni// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob gyur cig / ces pa 'di yang mnyan pa'i dbon po bla ma karma 'chi med kyi dgongs bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ sku gsum ngo bo 'dus pa'i dpal// dpal ldan mtsho skyes rdo rje mchog /mchog dngos grub pa'i 'bras stsol mgon// mgon des tshe rabs kun tu yang*// yang srid las nyon sgrib tshogs dag /dag pa'i zhing khams bgrod nus shog / ces karma rab gsal ngor spel/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyi thugs rje'i 'phrul// dbyer med gcig dril srid dang zhi ba'i dpal// ko sha'i mtshor 'khrungs 'chi med pad+ma 'byung*// sgo gsum phyag 'tshal yid sprul mchod pas mchod// nongs bshags rjes su yi rang chos 'khor bskor// gsol ba 'debs so deng 'dir skal ldan gyi// sgrib gnyis bag chags ma lus drungs phyung nas// yang dag rang byung ye shes ngo bo nyid// gnas lugs mngon gyur tshe gcig gdod ma'i mgon// go 'phang dam pa bde blag nyid thob shog

/de ltar bden tshig bden pa'i mthu ldan pa// bka' brgyud rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho dang*// rab 'byams rgyud sder 'brel ba'i yi dam lha// dpa' bo ḍā ki ye shes las 'jig rten// dregs byed dam can tshogs kyi mthu nus las// ji ltar smon bzhin de ltar lhun grub shog / ces na mda' dbon mo tshangs spyod dpal mos bskul bzhin/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos rdo smad mi rje'i mkhar gyi yang rtse'i lha khang nas spel ba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sku// 'chi med dbang bcu yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal// sku dang zhing khams ma lus lhun gyis grub// dri med mtsho skyes pad+ma las 'khrungs pa'i// o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la// rnam kun phyag 'tshal gsol btab bden pa'i mthus// lnga bdos bslad pa'i bstan dang 'gro ba kun// chos min chos ltar brdzu ba'i g.yang sa dang*// dug lngas rgyud bskul thar lam 'gog byed pa'i// rtag 'dzin zhen chags 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor rnams// bden med rang sar zhi zhing skye ba kun// dkar po dge bcu'i bsam pa lhun grub nas// ma nor lam ston chos dang 'phrad par shog / ces skyo brag dbon mo'i ngor spel/// / ༈ dpal ldan karma ka yi thugs rje'i 'od// kun tu snang ba'i legs byas rab gsal bas// gang 'dir skal ldan mos gus rtsa ba brtan// zhen log sgom gyi 'dab brgya rab grol nas// mi rtog ting 'dzin 'bras bu mchog brnyes shing*// bla med sku bzhi'i dbang phyug mngon gyur shog / ces rtogs ldan 'jam dbyangs ngor spel/// / ༈ gnas skabs bdud bzhi'i bar chad g.yul las rgyal// rnam par dag pa'i nges don gsang ba mchog /snying po'i brtan thob rang gzhan smin cing grol// sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur du thob par shog / ces pa'ang bsam sprul la smon lam du si tus spel/// / ༈ mchog gsum rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// mi mngon dbyings bzhugs ye shes spyan ldan rnams// thugs rje chen pos dgongs shing bskyab tu gsol// bdag gi rnam par dkar ba'i dge 'bras rnams// byang chub chen po'i rgyu ru yongs bsngos pas// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas bstan 'dzin rnams// zhabs pad yun brtan 'gro rnams bde skyid ldan// kun bzang thar pa'i lam sna zin gyur te// phyir mi ldog par bde chen zhing bgrod shog

/ ja dgon don gnyis lhun grub ngor spel/// / ༈ srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i yum// 'phags mchog bcom ldan 'das ma gang*// 'di nas byang chub thob kyi bar// lhag pa'i lhar gyur thugs rjes skyongs// rang grol ngor spel/// / ༈ swasti/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs// bden pa grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag dang pha mas gtsor byas rigs drug gi// sems can sdug bsngal mtsho las bsgral du gsol// rang gzhan rnams kyi dus gsum dus med kyi// dge ba'i rtsa ba mchog gsum rtsa gsum lha'i// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rten mchog rnams// bzhengs pa'i legs byas byang chub chen por bsngo// de ma thob bar tshe rabs kun tu yang*// dal rten thob cing mtshan ldan bla ma mjal// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas// smin cing grol ba'i lam bzang thob par shog /chos dang chos min ma nor ji bzhin par// gnas skabs tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*// nad gdon bar chad mi mthun nyer 'tshe zhi// rang byung lhan skyes 'od gsal phyag rgya che// gnyug ma chos sku'i rgyal sar dbang 'byor shog /nam zhig bde chen pad+mo bkod zhing du// brdzus te skyes nas sangs rgyas zhal mthong zhing*// bla med lung bstan dbugs dbyung thob nas su// phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang thob gyur cig / dad gsum 'gyur med chos tshul ldan pa karma'i bzhed ngor spel ba dge bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu/// / ༈ swa sti dza yan+tu/ bcom ldan lha yi lhar gyur rje btsun ma// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i byin rlabs klong yangs nas// thugs rje'i zla gzhon bdud rtsi'i dpal yon gyis// deng 'dir bde legs don kun grub gyur cig /'jig rten bkra shis phan dang bde ba'i gnas// thams cad lhun grub yid bzhin 'dod 'jo zhing*// 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub la sogs pa// thogs med 'grub cing tshe dpal ye shes rgyas// byang chub snying po mchog gi rtsa ba brtan// rang byung gdod ma'i lhan skyes chos kyi sku// gnas lugs ji bzhin mngon gyur mthar thug pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god nus shog

/ ces pa'ang dbon sprul karma 'byung gnas bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ dkon mchog 'dus pa'i bdag nyid mchog /rgyal dbang pad+mā ka ra yi// thugs rje'i char gyis skal ldan rnams// mi mthun 'gal rkyen ma lus zhi// rang byung stong gsal 'gyur med kyi// rang gdangs gshis kyi gnas lugs don// gang shar chos sku'i klong yangs su// rig stong ngang du grol gyur cig / ces pa'ang rab dga'i ngor spel/// / ༈ sku gsum bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung*// gang gi thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyis// 'gro rgyud sgrib gnyis bsreg gyur nas// rnam grol lam mchog myur gsal zhing*// mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od zhing du// rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras dbang bskur// sprul pas mtha' yas sems can kun// sgrol ba'i gnyen du deng gyur cig / ces pa'ang karma chos rgyal ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs rje'i dpal yon kun// gcig gyur o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung*// gang 'dul zhi dang khro bo'i gar rol pa// sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro 'dul rdzu 'phrul can// gang gi byin rlabs 'od stong gzi byin gyis// deng 'dir nyes gsum khri mun gtan bcil nas// thar pa dam pa'i go 'phang bla med par// ring min nyid du 'god pa'i skal ldan shog / ces sa tham mchog thub ngor spel// // ༈ swasti/ rgyal yum tshe sbyin tā re mas// deng 'dir rnam kun shis gyur ba'i// bde legs yongs 'du'i char rgyun gyis// tshe dang dpal grags ye shes gzi'i// snang ba rab rgyas don gnyis po// yongs grub 'di gtan sman pa yi// bsod nams rdul brtsegs lhun po ltar// srid rtser lham mer 'bar gyur cig / ces pa'ang dgyes mdzad ngor spel/// / ༈ dpal ldan phyogs dus bde bar gshegs rnams kyi// thugs rje'i gong bu gcig bsdus 'jig rten mgon// mngon snang mi bskyod rigs kyi cod pan can// karma ka des deng 'dir dge legs stsol// rnam dag bslab pa'i rtsa ba rab brtan cing*// tshul khrims phun tshogs yal 'dab kun tu khyab// bsdu dngos bzhi yi pad tshal dri bsung ldan// yongs 'du'i ljon bzhin dge 'dun sde 'phel shog

/chos spyod bcu dang 'khor lo rnam gnyis kyi// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan yongs su bsgreng bzhin par// dkar phyogs lha klu yis kyang srung byed nas// snying po'i ring lugs yun gnas dar rgyas shog /de ltar byin mthus 'gro drug sems can tshogs// srid mtsho las brgal myang 'das go 'phang thob// byang chub chen por mngon sangs rgyas pa yi// rgyal rnams smon pa yongs grub dbugs dbyung stsol//

ces 'jang yul thar pa'i lam 'dzin gling gi bla ma mthar phyin nas bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ 'jang yul gyi dge slong 'ga' zhig gi bzhed ngor smon lam gsol 'debs so sor spel pa ni/ mchog tu 'gyur med bde chen khams// mi 'gyur sgyu 'phrul drwa ba can// dpal ldan sdom pa deng nas bzung*// byang chub bar du 'bral med shog// / ༈ lhun grub gdod ma'i sangs rgyas che// kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur ba yi// thugs rjes 'di bzung byang chub bar// nam yang mi btang rjes 'dzin mdzod/// / ༈ khyab bdag rigs dkyil 'khor lo'i mgon// dpal ldan karma ka mchog des// 'di nas byang chub chen po'i bar// 'bral med rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/// / ༈ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// dkyil 'khor kun gtso 'khor lo sdom// 'bral med mi rtog ye shes che'i// 'bras bu mngon byang chub par shog// / ༈ rgyal kun thugs rje'i gar rol ba// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug karma ka /'di nas bla med byang chub bar// mi 'bral bde chen gtsug rol mdzod/// / ༈ dus gsum ston pa bde bar gshegs// yongs kyi spyi gzugs karma pa// rnam kun mi 'bral skal ldan gyi// yid kyi pad+mor 'bral med shog// / ༈ mkha' khyab thugs rje'i gter 'chang ba// mtha' bral phrin las rang bzhin can// rje btsun karma ka mchog gis// skye dang skye bar rjes 'dzin shog// / ༈ lhun grub ye shes snang ba can// khyab bdag bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon// rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// skye dang tshe rabs 'bral med shog// / ༈ ston mchog stobs bcu'i bdag nyid can// dus gsum rgyal kun gsang gsum gyi// phrin las mdzod 'chang karma kas// rnam kun rjes 'dzin byin gyis rlobs/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sku// sku gsum lhun grub yongs rdzogs dpal// dpal ldan rdo rje can zhabs mchog /mchog gis deng 'dir smin grol mdzod/// /

༈ rgyal kun phrin las mdzod 'chang ba// dpal ldan karma pa mchog des// rjes 'dzin byang chub go 'phang la// 'god par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/// / ༈ bde gshegs gsang gsum gter mnga' ba// thugs rje'i bdag nyid rgyal ba'i dbang*// gang des tshe rabs phreng ba ru// rjes 'dzin phyir mi ldog par shog// / ༈ sras bcas rgyal kun 'dus ba'i sku// 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// thugs rje'i bden pas byin brlab nas// smin grol dbang bzhi mchog thob shog// / ༈ tshe yi mchog sbyin 'phags ma yum// rnam kun lhag lhar bsnyen ba'i mthus// tshe dang ye shes 'byor pa rgyas// bkra shis don kun 'grub par shog// / ༈ chos sku mkha' dbyings yangs pa las// longs sku 'gag med sna tshogs 'char// sprul sku 'gro don phrin las can// karma ka des skyong gyur cig// / ༈ phrin las sna tshogs chu zla yi// rol pas dus gsum 'gro sgrol ba// dpal ldan karma ka mchog de// byang chub bar du 'bral med shog// / ༈ bu ram shing pa'i bstan mchog gi// phrin las 'dod dgur bsgyur mdzad pa// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje gang*// 'du 'bral med pa gcig tu smon/// / ༈ shes bya'i mkha' dbyings yangs pa la// blo gros nyi ma 'bum brdal bas// rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa'i gtso// dha rmā kā ras rjes bzung mdzod/// / ༈ rnam bzhi'i phrin las thams cad pa// lhun gyis grub pa'i bdag nyid can// drag po mngon spyod he ru ka /rdo rje ber gyis skyong gyur cig// / ༈ rab gsal thugs rje'i zla ris kyis// rab snang las nyon dri ma bsal// rab bsil byams pa'i chu rgyun can// rab dgyes mgon des skyong gyur cig// / ༈ bde chen rdo rje'i gar rol ba// e wam̐ zung 'jug bdag nyid can// dpal ldan sdom pa deng nas bzung*// byang chub bar du 'bral med shog// / ༈ snying rje tshad med phrin las kyi// ye shes rang gzugs 'jig rten mgon// mchog gis skye bar rjes bzung nas// sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur bar shog// /

༈ tshe dang 'od snang mtha' yas pa// pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs rje'i 'od// rab gsal snang bas 'jig rten gyi// khams rnams bde dge'i dpal rgyas shog// / ༈ tshe yi mchog sbyin tā re ma'i// thugs rje'i 'od snang dkar po yis// deng 'dir 'dzum phreng rab g.yos pas// kun nas kun tu shis gyur cig// / ༈ ston mchog mnyam med shākya'i tog /gang de'i bstan pa'i snying po ste// nges don sgrub brgyud lam 'jug rnams// chos spyod bya ba 'phel rgyas shog// / ༈ o rgyan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes// mchog gi byin rlabs 'od phreng gis// skal ldan sgrib gnyis khri mun gzhil// sku gsum bdag nyid che thob shog// / ༈ rgyal kun skyed yum 'phags ma sgrol// gang gi thugs rje'i bdud rtsi yis// deng 'dir rgyud smin tshe dpal dang*// ye shes snang ba rab rgyas shog// / ༈ rgyal ba rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi// gtso mchog sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung*// gang de'i byin rlabs smin gyur nas// snang srid dbang bsgyur nus thob shog// / ༈ mngon shes lnga ldan bde bar gshegs// don kun grub pas tshe rabs kun// rjes bzung so sor thar sgor zhugs/ dgra bcom 'bras thob sangs rgyas shog// / ༈ dus gsum sangs rgyas skyed pa'i yum// rdo rje btsun mos rjes 'dzin nas// mchog tu 'gyur med phyag rgya che'i// go 'phang dam pa myur thob shog// / ༈ ye shes dbyings las khro bo'i sku// snying rje'i thabs kyis gdug pa 'dul// ma hā kā la rdo rje ber// 'bral med phrin las bzhi 'grub shog// / ༈ kun bzang thugs rje'i gar rol pa// sprul bsgyur snang ba rtsa brgyud kyi// bla ma rnams kyis rjes bzung nas// mi rtog ye shes mngon gyur shog// / ༈ rgyal dbang mtshor 'khrungs pad 'byung gi// byin rlabs 'od phreng thugs rje'i zer// gang zhig dad ldan sgo gsum la// dbang bzhi myur stsol rgyud smin shog// /

༈ dpal ldan bstan srung rdo rje ber// mchog gi mthu stobs gzi 'bar bas// log 'dren thal bar bsreg pa yi// las bzhi'i phrin las deng sgrubs mdzod/// / ༈ tshe dbang dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i gter// lha sman rgyal mos deng 'di ru// rtag tu srung skyob mgon du ni// 'bral med bu bzhin brtse bar mdzod/// / ༈ shrī shrī swa sti/ srid gsum kun dgar byed pa yi// mchog gsum thugs rje'i nyin byed 'od // gang 'dir gsal bas 'gro rnams la// dge legs snang bas skyong gyur cig /dngos grub bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas gter// rtsa gsum byin rlabs chu shel dbang*// deng 'dir si ma pa'i yon tan gyis// bkra shis 'dzum phreng rgod gyur cig /lha chen 'jig rten skyong ba yi// dkar po'i sde ris dpung tshogs rnams// skal ldan bu bzhin bsrung ba yis// phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar mdzod// dza ya dza ya su dza ya// zhes bla ma mthar phyin par smon lam du spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun skyed yum tshe sbyin ma// 'phags mar gsol btab thugs rje yis// tshe dpal ye shes snang ba rgyas// don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis stsol/// / ༈ 'phags mchog lo ki shwa ra yi// byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i dpal yon gyis// deng 'dir bsam don chos 'phel zhing*// sku bzhi'i 'bras bu myur thob shog// / ༈ 'jam dpal dpa' bo brtse chen gyi// thugs bskyed zab mo'i 'od snang gis// skal ldan sgrib gnyis mun bcom nas// yang dag ye shes kun gsal mdzod/// / ༈ gsang bdag mthu stobs rdo rje 'dzin// mchog gi bden pas skyong gyur nas// gang 'dir nyer 'tshe yongs bral te// dkar po'i 'dod don lhun grub shog// / ༈ stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag bcom ldan 'das// lung rtogs dam pa'i chos kyi mchog /rig grol 'phags tshogs dge 'dun sde// mchog gsum thugs rje'i 'od dkar gyis// nye bar sim pa'i legs byas mthus// tshe dpal ku muta rnam par rgyas// chos mthun bsam pa lhun grub cing*// bde dga' rgya mtshos 'tsho gyur cig

/ mang kwa skal bzang ngor spel/// / ༈ stobs bcu'i stobs mnga' bcom ldan shākya thub// chos nyid rang bzhin smra bsam blo 'das yum// rig dang grol ba'i sar gnas 'phags dge 'dun// rin chen rnam gsum skyabs su bsten pa'i mthus// 'phral snang nyon mongs mun stug rgyang bsring zhing*// bla med thar pa bde ba'i 'od snang gi// sems nyid chos sku'i nyin byed 'char gyur nas// rang gzhan rnam mkhyen go 'phang sbyor nus shog / bstan 'phel ngor spel/// / ༈ karma pa yi bstan la tshul bzhin du// zhugs 'di sngon bsags bsod nams 'bras bur nges// des na bka' brgyud bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin// sdom pa gsum gyis rang rgyud smin gyur cig / karma tshe dbang legs pa'i ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun spyi mes mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*// dbyer med 'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs// rnam kun mi phyed 'dun pas gsol ba 'debs// thugs yid gcig 'dres mchog thun dngos grub stsol// bdag gi rnam kun bsam spyod ji snyed pa// chos min gegs gyur nam yang mi 'byung zhing*// rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam zab mo yi// zung 'jug 'pho bde'i ye shes brnyes par shog /rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig rtsa ba ni// rang lus lha sku 'dzin med gsal ba dang*// ngag gi sngags bzlas yid kyi ting 'dzin sgom// sku gsung thugs kyi rnal 'byor 'bral med shog /rang sems ye nas skye 'gags gnas gsum bral// spang blang yul med chos sku'i gar bsgyur tshe// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig lta bas bskang*// srung du med pa'i dam tshig la gnas shog /gnas skabs dran pas ma zin rkyen dbang gi /'khrul dris bslad pa'i nyon mongs rtog tshogs kun// ye nas ma grub rang sems rig pa'i mdangs// yin la ngo shes nongs pa ka dag shog /chos kun 'dun pa'i rtse la gnas gyur pas// zag bcas zag med dge rtsa byas so cog

/thams cad 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur// byang chub chen por yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// de ltar bsngos pa'i mthu nus dge rtsa yis// bla ma'i zhabs brtan bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas// 'gro rnams dge spyod bdag dang 'brel bcas kun// kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang myur thog shog / ces pa'ang lha lcam bde chen dbang gi rgyal ma'i bzhed ngor spel ba maṅga laṃ/// /
